title: Congestion Pricing in Low-Altitude Airspace: A Stackelberg Approachto UTM Markets
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Congestion Pricing in Low-Altitude Airspace: A Stackelberg Approachto UTM Markets
detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of drone operations is turning low-altitude airspace into an economically significant but increasingly congested resource. Although the Unmanned Traffic Management (UTM) literature has advanced substantially in operational, safety, and interoperability issues, the economic mechanisms required to price airspace, regulate market entry, and internalize congestion externalities remain largely underdeveloped. This paper addresses that gap by proposing an analytical framework in which the regulator and competing drone operators interact as a two-stage Stackelberg game. In the base formulation, the regulator sets a unit tariff to maximize regulatory revenue; in the extended formulation, the regulator adopts a Pigouvian stance, internalizing congestion externalities that scale with aggregate traffic density. We derive closed-form expressions for the equilibrium tariff, market quantity, and operator profits, and we prove that the optimal congestion-aware tariff is strictly increasing in the regional congestion parameter, providing a theoretical foundation for spatially and temporally differentiated pricing. The model is calibrated with 2025 operational data from SARPAS the Brazilian national UTM platform administered by DECEA and its robustness is assessed through Monte Carlo simulation over stochastic demand and cost parameters. The results reveal a fundamental trade-off: increased competition enhancesallocative efficiency and price stability but erodes the regulator’s revenue base and amplifies the sensitivity of welfare to congestion costs. The empirical calibration shows that congestion-efficient tariffs in dense urban cells (São Paulo) are 40–60% higher than a uniform national tariff, a magniude that uniform pricing cannot accommodate without substantial efficiency losses. These findings contribute to the transport-economics, market-design, and UTM literatures by integrating strategic regulation, congestion externalities, and empirical calibration within a single framework, and they offer actionable guidance for the design of scalable, financially sustainable UTM systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个两阶段Stackelberg博弈框架，研究无人机交通管理中的拥堵定价与市场准入监管问题，并用巴西国家UTM平台SARPAS的2025年运营数据进行校准，发现拥堵有效的关税在密集城市区域（如圣保罗）比统一国家关税高出40-60%。
AI.research_question: 如何设计经济机制来对低空空域进行定价、监管市场准入并将拥堵外部性内部化？
AI.motivation: 无人机交通管理（UTM）文献在运营、安全与互操作性方面取得显著进展，但定价空域、监管市场准入和内部化拥堵外部性的经济机制仍不成熟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两阶段Stackelberg博弈：监管者（第一阶段）设定单位关税，无人机运营商（第二阶段）竞争性进入；基础形式追求监管收入最大化，扩展形式采用庇古税立场内部化拥堵外部性。
AI.method: 博弈论建模推导封闭解；巴西SARPAS平台2025年运营数据校准；蒙特卡洛模拟进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 最优拥堵感知关税严格随区域拥堵参数递增；竞争增强提升配置效率与价格稳定性，但侵蚀监管者收入基础并放大拥堵成本对福利的敏感性；圣保罗等密集城市单元的拥堵有效关税比统一国家关税高40-60%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将战略监管、拥堵外部性与经验校准整合在同一框架内，为拥堵定价提供了空间与时间差异化定价的理论基础，揭示了竞争与监管收入之间的根本权衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计可扩展、财务可持续的UTM系统提供可操作指导，支持空间和时间差异化的拥堵定价策略。

title: Forecast-Performance-Calibrated Robust Scheduling of CHP-Centered Microgrids Under Coupled Electric–Thermal Load Uncertainty
affiliations: Clarkson University

detail.title: Forecast-Performance-Calibrated Robust Scheduling of CHP-Centered Microgrids Under Coupled Electric–Thermal Load Uncertainty
detail.abstract: Combined heat and power (CHP)-centered microgrids are highly sensitive in day-ahead scheduling to uncertainty in electric and heating load forecasts, yet such uncertainty is often represented using fixed-percentage margins or generic uncertainty sets that do not reflect historical forecast behavior. To address this gap, this paper proposes a data-driven robust unit commitment and economic dispatch (UC/ED) framework that links forecast-performance-based uncertainty learning with tractable robust scheduling. Uncertainty bounds are learned from historical actual-to-forecast ratios using empirical quantile analysis and are constructed separately for electric and heating demands to capture season-dependent and load-specific forecast error characteristics. These learned bounds are then embedded in a budgeted robustmixed-integer linear programming model that co-optimizes CHP units, battery energy storage, photovoltaic generation, and grid transactions while preserving electric–thermal coupling. A case study using IEEE Dataport residential building data shows pronounced seasonal differences in learned uncertainty bounds, withwinter 85th-percentile deviations of 24% for electric load and 19% for heating load, compared with 5% and 4% in autumn. These differences lead to markedly different robustness premiums: operating cost increases by 34.0% in winter but only 10.0% in autumn from the deterministic to the most conservative case.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种数据驱动的鲁棒调度框架，利用历史预测误差学习不确定性边界，并将其嵌入含CHP微网的两阶段机组组合与经济调度模型中，案例显示夏季和冬季的不确定性边界及鲁棒成本显著不同。
AI.research_question: 如何在含热电联产微网的日前调度中，利用历史预测行为学习不确定性边界，实现数据驱动的鲁棒优化？
AI.motivation: 现有方法多采用固定百分比裕度或通用不确定性集，无法反映历史预测误差特征，导致调度方案过于保守或不够鲁棒。
AI.theoretical_framework: 鲁棒优化、经验分位数分析、预算鲁棒混合整数线性规划。
AI.method: 基于历史实际与预测比率，利用经验分位数分析分季节、分负荷类型学习不确定性边界，嵌入预算鲁棒MILP模型协同优化CHP、储能、光伏及电网交互。
AI.findings: 冬季电负荷85分位偏差达24%、热负荷19%，秋季仅5%和4%；最保守情形下冬季运营成本增加34%，秋季仅增加10%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将预测性能学习与可处理鲁棒调度理论结合，提出数据驱动的耦合不确定边界构建方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为微网运营商提供基于历史数据的实用鲁棒调度工具，可显著降低保守性，提升经济性。

title: Star myopia: Academician leaders and university technology transfer
affiliations: Nanjing University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Star myopia: Academician leaders and university technology transfer
detail.abstract: Academically accomplished stars in scientific fields are highly sought after by universities and even government departments. However, the actual impact of these academician leaders on university R&D activities remains elusive. Employing a difference-in-differences (DID) approach, this study delves into the causal link between star scientists’ leadership and university technology transfer. Findings reveal that appointing academicians as university presidents significantly diminishes technology transfer levels in the first two years, particularly in non-elite universities and those highly reliant on government funding. Such appointments exacerbate misallocation of research resources and reduce productivity, despite showing no positive effect on the acquisition of research funding. While publication quantity remains unaffected, academic impact wanes. Conversely, universities led by less renowned national-level talents witness improved research efficiency and technology transfer. This study underscores the potential lack of effective research leadership among star scientists, highlighting the perils of “star myopia” in academic appointments.

AI.tldr: 本文利用双重差分法研究院士担任大学校长对技术转移的影响，发现初期会显著降低技术转移水平，尤其在非精英大学和依赖政府资助的高校中，原因在于研究资源错配和效率下降，揭示了“明星科学家”在领导岗位上可能缺乏有效管理能力的问题。
AI.research_question: 明星科学家（院士）担任大学校长对高校技术转移的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 学术明星在科学界备受追捧，常被任命为大学甚至政府部门领导，但其实际领导效能（尤其是对研发活动的影响）尚不明确，存在“明星近视”现象的潜在风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、领导力理论、资源配置理论、技术转移与创新经济学
AI.method: 双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences, DID）
AI.findings: （1）院士任校长在任职前两年显著降低技术转移水平；（2）该负面效应在非精英大学和高度依赖政府资助的大学中尤为突出；（3）导致研究资源错配加剧、生产率下降；（4）研究经费获取无显著正向影响；（5）发表数量未受影响但学术影响力下降；（6）相比之下，知名度较低的国家级人才任校长反而提升了研究效率和技术转移。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次实证揭示了明星科学家在行政领导岗位上的负面效应，挑战了“学术明星=优秀领导”的隐含假设，丰富了领导力与创新管理理论中关于“明星近视”的讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高校和政府的人事任命决策提供警示：不应盲目迷信学术明星的领导能力，需更加注重候选人的管理才能与组织匹配度，以避免资源错配和创新效率损失。

title: Exploring uncertainties across the modelling chain in ML-based streamflow forecasting
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Belgrade, University of New South Wales (UNSW) - School of Civil and Environmental Engineering, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Exploring uncertainties across the modelling chain in ML-based streamflow forecasting
detail.abstract: Operational streamflow forecasts underpin flood preparedness and reservoir operations, yet their utility is often constrained by poorly characterized and attributed predictive uncertainty. In machine-learning-based forecasting, uncertainty is frequently omitted or reported as a single aggregate output, leaving it unclear which parts of the end-to-end forecasting chain drive overconfidence and forecast degradation, particularly with increasing lead time. In this work, we develop an end-to-end uncertainty decomposition framework for operational streamflow forecasting that attributes predictive uncertainty across meteorological forcing choice, feature design, model architecture, hyperparameter optimization, and training variability, evaluated across multi-day horizons. The decomposition reveals a systematic, horizon-dependent shift in dominant uncertainty sources, with forcing-related contributions increasing with lead time while model-structure and feature choices remain influential at shorter horizons. During high-flow events, predictive intervals remain essential because pipeline heterogeneity can bias the central estimate even when ensemble dispersion widens appropriately. Tuning contributes little to the uncertainty budget but strongly affects compute–skill trade-offs, with Bayesian optimization delivering the most favorable cost–benefit performance under the tested constraints. Together, these results provide actionable guidance for operational freshwater management, showing where investment yields the largest reliability gains: model design at short lead times and forcing quality at longer lead times. This guidance can reduce the risk of costly or unsafe decisions in flood preparedness, reservoir operation, and other critical decision-making contexts in water management.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个端到端的不确定性分解框架，用于分析机器学习驱动的径流预报中不同来源（气象强迫、特征设计、模型架构、超参数优化、训练变异性）的预测不确定性贡献，发现主导不确定性来源随预报时程发生系统性转移：短时程以模型设计和特征选择为主，长时程以气象强迫质量为主。超参数调优对不确定性影响小但显著影响计算-技能权衡。
AI.research_question: 在机器学习驱动的径流预报中，预测不确定性在不同来源（气象强迫、特征设计、模型架构、超参数优化、训练变异性）之间如何分配，以及这些不确定性来源如何随预报时程变化？
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习径流预报通常将不确定性视为单一聚合输出，或直接省略，导致无法识别预报链中哪些环节导致了过度自信或预报退化，尤其随着预报时程增加，不确定性来源归属问题更加突出。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不确定性分解框架（Uncertainty Decomposition Framework），将端到端预报链中的预测不确定性分解为气象强迫选择、特征设计、模型架构、超参数优化和训练变异性五个来源。
AI.method: 开发端到端不确定性分解框架，在多时程（multi-day horizons）预报设置下，系统分解和量化五个不确定性来源的贡献，并在高流量事件中评估预测区间表现。
AI.findings: （1）不确定性主导来源随预报时程系统性转移：长时程气象强迫贡献增大，短时程模型结构和特征选择影响显著；（2）高流量事件中，即使集合离散度合理增大，管道异质性仍可能导致中心估计偏差，预测区间不可或缺；（3）超参数调优对不确定性预算贡献很小，但显著影响计算-技能权衡，贝叶斯优化在测试约束下性价比最优。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个将径流预报不确定性端到端分解到具体来源的系统框架，揭示了不确定性来源随预报时程的系统性转移规律，为理解机器学习水文预报的校准误差提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为运营水资源管理提供了可操作的指导：短时程应投资于模型设计，长时程应投资于气象强迫质量，从而在洪水准备、水库调度等关键决策中降低代价高昂或不安全决策的风险。

title: The Evolving Prominence of Framing Approaches in New Ventures Across Development Stages and Innovation Types
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Nyenrode Business University and Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Rotterdam School of Management (RSM), Amsterdam Business School

detail.title: The Evolving Prominence of Framing Approaches in New Ventures Across Development Stages and Innovation Types
detail.abstract: Entrepreneurship research highlights the importance of communication in securing stakeholder support, yet we have limited understanding of how entrepreneurial framing evolves as ventures develop. In this study, we examine how new ventures adapt their framing over time. Drawing on a qualitative study of 58 ventures in the Netherlands and Germany, we identify three distinct framing approaches, positioning, grounding, and envisioning, and show that they vary in their relative prominence over time. Rather than replacing one another, these approaches can be selectively reweighted as ventures navigate changing legitimacy demands across development stages. We further show that these patterns differ depending on whether ventures pursue radical or incremental innovations. We develop a process model of entrepreneurial framing that explains how ventures can sustain legitimacy over time.

AI.tldr: 本文基于对荷兰和德国58家创业企业的质性研究，识别出三种创业框架策略（定位、奠基、愿景），并揭示这些策略如何随着企业发展阶段和合法性需求的变化而动态调整，且这种调整模式在激进型与渐进型创新企业之间存在显著差异。
AI.research_question: 创业企业的框架策略如何随时间演变？
AI.motivation: 创业研究强调沟通对获取利益相关者支持的重要性，但我们对创业框架如何随企业发展而演变的理解仍然有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创业框架、合法性理论、组织发展阶段理论
AI.method: 质性研究，对荷兰和德国58家创业企业进行纵向分析
AI.findings: 识别出三种框架策略：定位、奠基、愿景；这三种策略在不同发展阶段的相对重要性不同，可选择性重新加权以应对合法性需求的变化；激进型与渐进型创新企业的框架演变模式存在差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了创业框架的过程模型，解释了企业如何随时间持续维持合法性；揭示了框架策略的动态重加权机制而非简单替代；区分了激进与渐进创新情境下框架演变的差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业者提供了如何根据发展阶段和合法性需求调整沟通策略的实践指导；帮助创业者理解激进与渐进创新情境下框架策略的不同适用性。

title: Spatiotemporal Propagation of Travel Time Variability in Bus Networks: A Network-Based Analysis of Critical Hubs
affiliations: University of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Spatiotemporal Propagation of Travel Time Variability in Bus Networks: A Network-Based Analysis of Critical Hubs
detail.abstract: Travel time variability is a key challenge in public transport systems, yet its propagation mechanisms across urban networks remain insufficiently understood. This paper introduces a data-driven temporal network framework for reconstructing and analyzing the spatiotemporal propagation of travel time variability from large-scale GPS observations in urban bus systems. Unlike conventional reliability approaches based on predefined topological structures or static metrics, the proposed methodology infers directed propagation pathways directly from empirical temporal interactions.A PageRank-based centrality measure is used to identify critical hubs that drive the spread of variability across the network. The framework is applied to the bus network of Tenerife, revealing a heterogeneous spatial structure with a limited set of dominant hubs. Temporal analysis comparing peak and off-peak periods shows a moderate overlap in hub sets (Jaccard index = 0.60) and a high rank correlation (Spearman rho = 0.865), indicating a stable backbone of influential nodes. However, substantial rank shifts are observed, highlighting a dynamic redistribution of propagation roles under different demand conditions.The results demonstrate that travel time variability propagation is governed by a hybrid structure combining persistent core hubs and temporally adaptive nodes. These findings provide new insights into the dynamics of public transport systems and offer practical implications for network monitoring, robustness analysis, and targeted interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个数据驱动的时间网络框架，利用大规模GPS数据重建和分析城市公交系统中行程时间变异性的时空传播机制。通过PageRank中心性识别关键枢纽，并在特内里费公交网络中进行实证，发现变异性传播由持久核心枢纽和时变节点共同驱动。
AI.research_question: 城市公交网络中，行程时间变异性如何在时空上传播？其传播枢纽具有怎样的结构特征和动态变化？
AI.motivation: 行程时间变异性是公共交通系统的关键挑战，但其在复杂城市网络中的传播机制尚不明确，传统方法依赖预定义的拓扑结构或静态指标，无法捕捉实际的时空传播动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间网络理论（Temporal Network）、PageRank中心性、传播动力学
AI.method: 数据驱动的时间网络框架：从大规模GPS观测数据中推断有向传播路径，利用PageRank中心性识别关键枢纽，并通过Jaccard指数和Spearman秩相关进行时段比较分析。
AI.findings: 传播网络具有异质性空间结构，仅少数枢纽主导传播；高峰与平峰期枢纽集存在中等重叠（Jaccard指数=0.60），秩相关高（Spearman rho=0.865），但存在显著的秩次变动，表明传播角色随需求条件动态调整。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了行程时间变异性传播的混合结构（持久核心枢纽+时变适应性节点），突破了传统静态网络分析的局限，为公共交通系统的传播动力学提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公交网络监控、鲁棒性分析和针对性干预（如枢纽识别与优先级排序）提供了实用工具和方法支持。

title: Port performance evaluation in a competitive environment: A Multi-Port evidence-based approach
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Port performance evaluation in a competitive environment: A Multi-Port evidence-based approach
detail.abstract: This study aims to provide a new framework for evaluating port performance by incorporating the perspectives of diverse stakeholders. The study’s originality is in introducing transport network of roads and railways and port centrality as indicators for assessing the relative importance of port geographic location and for evaluating port performance. Based on data retrieved from literature and expert opinions, a model for measuring port performance is established in a several hierarchical structure which includes assessments and relative importance of each criterion and sub-criterion. First, the issue of port performance is introduced, followed by its formulation as a multiple attribute decision analysis problem. To deal with a formulated port performance assessment problem of both a quantitative and qualitative nature under uncertainties, rule and utility-based techniques for transforming assessment information are applied. A decision making trial and evaluation laboratory is applied to calculate the weights of dependent criteria in the model, while Evidential Reasoning algorithm is applied to calculate a comprehensive and belief-based assessments as well as to rank ports with expected utilities. By providing a flexible diagnostic framework and model, study enables stakeholders to effectively measure and monitor port performance according to their specific requirements and to identify port’s strengths and weaknesses.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个融合多利益相关方视角、考虑交通网络和港口中心性的港口绩效评估新框架，并运用决策实验室分析（DEMATEL）和证据推理（ER）算法构建了多层级评估模型。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够纳入多元利益相关方视角、考量港口地理区位相对重要性的港口绩效评估框架？
AI.motivation: 现有港口绩效评估方法未能充分纳入多利益相关方视角，且缺乏对港口地理区位重要性（如公路、铁路交通网络及港口中心性）的系统考量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多属性决策分析理论、决策实验室分析（DEMATEL）、证据推理（ER）算法。
AI.method: 基于文献和专家意见构建多层级指标结构；运用规则和效用转换技术处理定性与定量信息；采用DEMATEL计算依赖指标的权重；运用ER算法进行综合信念评估并排序港口预期效用。
AI.findings: 该框架能够根据利益相关方的特定需求灵活评估和监控港口绩效，识别港口的优势与劣势。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将交通网络（公路、铁路）和港口中心性作为评估港口地理区位相对重要性的指标引入绩效评估模型；将港口绩效评估问题系统表述为多属性决策分析问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个灵活的诊断框架，使利益相关方可根据自身需求有效衡量和监控港口绩效，并识别港口的关键优势与短板。

detail.abstract: This article presents a complete, real-world B2B sales case from China's insurance industry-the Huarwei New Energy Plant project, with an annual premium budget of RMB 8 million. The seller, facing two strong competitors, eventually won the 8.2

AI.tldr: 本文呈现了中国保险行业一个真实的B2B销售案例——华为新能源工厂项目，年保费预算达800万元人民币。卖方在面临两个强劲竞争对手的情况下，最终赢得了价值820万元的保单。
AI.research_question: 在B2B销售中，面对强劲竞争对手时，保险公司如何通过销售策略赢得大额保单？
AI.motivation: 通过分析中国保险行业真实的B2B大额销售案例，揭示成功赢得竞争性订单的关键因素和策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: B2B销售理论、竞争策略理论、客户关系管理理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，基于中国保险行业真实的B2B销售案例进行深入分析。
AI.findings: 卖方在面临两个强劲竞争对手的情况下，成功赢得了年保费预算800万元的华为新能源工厂项目，最终成交金额达820万元。
AI.theory_contributions: 为B2B销售理论提供了中国保险行业的实证案例，丰富了竞争性大额销售策略的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为B2B销售人员提供了可借鉴的竞争性大额销售实战策略和技巧，特别是在保险行业的应用。

title: A novel dynamic adaptive new information priority grey convolutional model and its application in renewable energy generation prediction
affiliations: Henan Agricultural University, Henan Agricultural University, Henan Agricultural University and Henan Agricultural University

detail.title: A novel dynamic adaptive new information priority grey convolutional model and its application in renewable energy generation prediction
detail.abstract: Accurately forecasting renewable energy is crucial for future power grid planning and operation. However, different types of renewable energy exhibit differentiated nonlinear characteristics, which makes forecasting extremely challenging. To address this, a novel dynamic adaptive grey convolution model is proposed. Meanwhile, hydropower with a saturated “S”-shaped growth trend, and bioenergy with monotonically increasing yet unstable change rates are selected as research objects. A comparison with five benchmark models confirms the forecasting reliability of the proposed model. The forecasting results show that the average annual growth rates of hydropower and bioenergy generation during the forecasting period are 0.55% and 21.13% respectively. Accurately forecasting the growth trajectories of hydropower and bioenergy generation not only optimizes renewable energy integration efficiency but also delivers actionable, data-driven insights to support strategic decision-making in sustainable energy policy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新型动态自适应灰色卷积模型，用于准确预测具有不同非线性特征的可再生能源（水电和生物能源）的发电增长轨迹。
AI.research_question: 如何准确预测不同类型可再生能源（水电和生物能源）的非线性发电增长趋势？
AI.motivation: 不同可再生能源具有差异化的非线性特征，传统预测模型难以同时准确捕捉这些复杂动态，亟需一种新型动态自适应预测方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态自适应灰色卷积模型（Dynamic Adaptive Grey Convolution Model）
AI.method: 提出动态自适应灰色卷积模型，以水电（饱和S形增长趋势）和生物能源（单调递增但变化率不稳定）为研究对象，与五种基准模型进行对比验证。
AI.findings: 所提模型预测可靠性优于五种基准模型；预测期内水电和生物能源发电年均增长率分别为0.55%和21.13%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种能够自适应处理不同类型可再生能源非线性特征的灰色卷积预测模型，拓展了灰色系统理论在能源预测领域的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 准确预测水电和生物能源增长轨迹可优化可再生能源并网效率，并为可持续能源政策的战略决策提供数据驱动的 actionable 洞见。

title: LHEMO: LLM-Based Heuristic Evolution for Multi-Objective Sensor-Weapon-Target Assignment
affiliations: National University of Defense Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, National University of Defense Technology, National University of Defense Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, National University of Defense Technology, National University of Defense Technology, National University of Defense Technology and National University of Defense Technology

detail.title: LHEMO: LLM-Based Heuristic Evolution for Multi-Objective Sensor-Weapon-Target Assignment
detail.abstract: The multi-objective sensor--weapon--target assignment (SWTA) problem requires the coordinated allocation of heterogeneous sensing and action resources under conflicting objectives such as mission effectiveness, resource consumption, and response time. Existing SWTA solvers, including classical multi-objective evolutionary algorithms and recent large language model (LLM)-based automated heuristic design (AHD) methods, either rely heavily on hand-crafted search components or transfer poorly to SWTA because of heterogeneous entities, strict feasibility requirements, and the need for Pareto-oriented feedback. To address these challenges, we propose LHEMO, an LLM-based heuristic evolution framework for multi-objective SWTA. LHEMO adopts a bi-level architecture in which the outer level evolves executable heuristic programs through LLM-guided operators, while the inner level evaluates each candidate within a unified multi-objective solver. Within this architecture, two reconstruction operators expand exploration through line-level and module-level code regeneration, a validation-and-repair mechanism recovers invalid candidates, a cross-generation reflection mechanism reuses evolutionary experience, and a structured seed heuristic stabilizes early-stage search. A Pareto-oriented fitness based on hypervolume and a feasibility penalty further guides the evolution toward high-quality trade-off solutions. Experiments on a benchmark ranging from 8 to 320 targets show that LHEMO consistently outperforms both classical multi-objective baselines and representative LLM-based AHD baselines, achieving up to 191% hypervolume improvement on the largest-scale instances. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of LLM-driven heuristic evolution as a practical paradigm for structured, constraint-intensive multi-objective resource allocation problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LHEMO框架，利用大语言模型驱动的启发式进化方法解决多目标传感器-武器-目标分配问题，在8到320个目标的基准测试中优于传统多目标进化算法和现有LLM-based方法，最高实现191%的超体积改进。
AI.research_question: 如何利用大语言模型自动化设计高效启发式算法，以解决异构实体、严格可行性约束和帕累托导向反馈需求下的多目标传感器-武器-目标分配问题？
AI.motivation: 现有解决多目标SWTA问题的方法存在明显局限：经典多目标进化算法过度依赖手工设计的搜索组件，而基于LLM的自动化启发式设计方法由于异构实体、严格可行性约束和帕累托导向反馈的缺失，迁移效果不佳。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双层进化架构：外层通过LLM引导的算子进化可执行的启发式程序，内层在统一的多目标求解器中评估候选方案；帕累托导向适应度（基于超体积）和可行性惩罚引导进化。
AI.method: 提出LHEMO框架，包含：1）双层架构（外层进化启发式程序+内层求解器评估）；2）两种重构算子（行级和模块级代码再生）；3）验证-修复机制恢复无效候选；4）跨代反思机制重用进化经验；5）结构化种子启发式稳定早期搜索。通过基准实验验证效果。
AI.findings: 在8至320个目标的基准测试中，LHEMO始终优于经典多目标基线和代表性LLM-based AHD基线，最大规模实例上实现191%的超体积改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了LLM驱动的启发式进化作为解决结构化、约束密集型多目标资源分配问题的实用范式，验证了LLM在自动化算法设计中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多目标传感器-武器-目标分配问题提供了性能显著优于现有方案的自动化求解方法，最高191%的超体积改进具有实际军事应用价值。

title: Statistical Reliability of Gradient-Boosted Ensembles versus ANFIS for Daily Suspended Sediment Concentration Prediction in a Monsoon-Dominated, Highly Variable River Basin
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Tribhuvan University - Institute of Engineering Pulchowk Campus

detail.title: Statistical Reliability of Gradient-Boosted Ensembles versus ANFIS for Daily Suspended Sediment Concentration Prediction in a Monsoon-Dominated, Highly Variable River Basin
detail.abstract: Accurate daily suspended sediment concentration (SSC) prediction is essential for hydropower reservoir management in monsoon-dominated, highly variable river systems. This study compares LightGBM and CatBoost against the Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) using eight years of daily hydrometeorological data from the Jalkundi catchment, West Rapti River, Nepal (WY2016–WY2023). A five-fold expanding-window cross-validation framework was combined with a triple significance protocol comprising a one-sample t-test, Wilcoxon signed-rank test, and 10,000-iteration bootstrap confidence interval, with the sediment rating curve (R² = 0.1545) as the null hypothesis. LightGBM satisfied all three criteria (t-test: p = 0.010; Wilcoxon: p = 0.031; bootstrap 95% CI: [0.299, 0.581]; test R² = 0.627). CatBoost attained marginally higher test R² (0.633) but failed the Wilcoxon test (p = 0.063), indicating borderline reliability. ANFIS achieved test-year R² = 0.495 yet a cross-validated mean of 0.042 ± 0.249 (95% CI: [−0.187, 0.257]), failing all significance tests. This collapse is attributed to the structural curse of dimensionality, which restricts ANFIS inputs to five of thirteen available features, producing severely degraded high-flow performance (R² = −2.083). Annual sediment load errors were −6.5% (LightGBM), −12.6% (CatBoost), and −28.2% (ANFIS). These results establish that gradient-boosted ensembles substantially outperform ANFIS in high-dimensional SSC modelling in monsoon-dominated catchments, and that expanding-window cross-validation with formal significance testing is indispensable for credible model evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了LightGBM、CatBoost与ANFIS在尼泊尔西拉普蒂河流域日输沙浓度预测中的表现，结果表明梯度提升集成模型显著优于ANFIS，其中LightGBM通过了所有显著性检验，而ANFIS因维数灾难在高流量时段表现严重退化。
AI.research_question: 在季风主导、高度变异河流系统中，梯度提升集成模型（LightGBM和CatBoost）与自适应神经模糊推理系统（ANFIS）在日悬沙浓度预测中孰优孰劣？
AI.motivation: 水库管理需要准确的日悬沙浓度预测，但传统方法（如泥沙输移曲线）表现不佳，而机器学习方法在高维、非平稳水文环境中的适用性尚缺乏严谨的跨验证对比。
AI.theoretical_framework: 梯度提升集成学习理论；维数灾难理论；自适应神经模糊推理系统（ANFIS）结构限制理论；统计显著性检验框架（单样本t检验、Wilcoxon符号秩检验、bootstrap置信区间）。
AI.method: 使用尼泊尔Jalkundi流域8年（WY2016–WY2023）每日水文气象数据，采用五折扩展窗口交叉验证，并结合三重显著性检验协议（单样本t检验、Wilcoxon符号秩检验、10,000次迭代bootstrap置信区间），以泥沙输移曲线（R²=0.1545）为零假设。
AI.findings: LightGBM满足全部三项显著性检验（检验R²=0.627）；CatBoost检验R²略高（0.633）但未通过Wilcoxon检验；ANFIS检验R²=0.495但交叉验证均值仅0.042±0.249，未通过任何显著性检验，高流量时期R²为−2.083。年度泥沙负荷误差：LightGBM为−6.5%，CatBoost为−12.6%，ANFIS为−28.2%。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了梯度提升集成模型在高维SSC建模中系统性地优于ANFIS，揭示了ANFIS因结构维数灾难在高流量条件下的严重性能退化机制，并建立了扩展窗口交叉验证结合形式化显著性检验的评估方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为季风主导流域的水库泥沙管理提供了经过严格统计检验的高精度预测工具推荐（LightGBM），并指出了ANFIS在实际应用中因输入限制导致的高流量预测失灵的局限性。

title: The Gilded Cage: A Theory of Covert Control in Leader-Subordinate Relationships
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Gilded Cage: A Theory of Covert Control in Leader-Subordinate Relationships
detail.abstract: A financial services manager kept a toxic subordinate busy with choice projects—not to develop him, but to monitor him. A university chair gave a complaining faculty member preferred teaching assignments before he could ask, not because he deserved them, but to prevent him from going to the dean. These leaders built a "gilded cage": a relationship appearing as genuine investment but functioning as covert control. Leaders face this dilemma when subordinates cannot be punished or terminated—due to legal protections, political connections, or organizational constraints—but cannot be ignored. This article introduces containment leadership—a leader's strategic allocation of resources and proximity to monitor, pacify, and limit a subordinate's potential for disruption—and integrates conservation of resources, social exchange, attribution, and surveillance theories to explain why leaders contain, why subordinates remain unaware, and how containment operates. Four dimensions—performative investment, surveillance proximity, preemptive pacification, affective dissonance—articulate containment’s structure. A multi-level model shows how containment creates self-reinforcing dynamics that trap leaders, subordinates, and organizations. The theory challenges core assumptions in leader-member exchange and social exchange theory by revealing that behavioral markers of high-quality relationships can coexist with unilateral deception. It extends conservation of resources theory by demonstrating that resource protection strategies can become resource-depleting traps. Ethical implications and a research agenda address a phenomenon defined by invisibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"遏制型领导"（Containment Leadership）概念，指领导者通过表面上的积极投资（如分配好项目、优先排课）来隐蔽地监控和限制那些无法被惩罚或解雇的"有毒"下属。文章整合了资源保存理论、社会交换理论、归因理论和监控理论，揭示了这种"镀金牢笼"式关系的四维结构及其自我强化的陷阱。
AI.research_question: 当领导者无法惩罚或解雇下属（因法律保护、政治关系或组织约束），又无法忽视其破坏性时，他们如何通过表面上的积极资源分配来隐蔽地控制这类下属？这种"遏制型领导"的内在机制和动态过程是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统领导力理论（如LMX）假设高质量关系建立在真诚互惠基础上，但现实中存在领导者对"不可触碰"的有毒下属进行表面投资、实为监控的隐蔽行为。现有理论无法解释这种"积极行为背后的消极意图"现象，需要新的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合资源保存理论（COR）、社会交换理论、归因理论和监控理论，构建遏制型领导的理论基础。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念开发，基于多理论整合提出四维结构和多层次模型。
AI.findings: 1. 遏制型领导包含四个维度：表演性投资（Performative Investment）、监控性接近（Surveillance Proximity）、先发制人的安抚（Preemptive Pacification）、情感失调（Affective Dissonance）。2. 遏制行为形成自我强化的动态循环，将领导者、下属和组织都困在其中。3. 高质量的LMX关系表征（资源分配、亲近互动）可以与单方面欺骗共存，挑战了传统社会交换理论的核心假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战LMX和社会交换理论的核心假设：证明表面上的高质量关系表征可能源于单方面的欺骗性控制，而非真诚互惠。2. 拓展资源保存理论：揭示资源保护策略（分配资源以控制下属）反而可能成为消耗领导者资源的陷阱。3. 首次系统化提出"遏制型领导"概念，填补了关于"领导者如何隐蔽管控不可触碰下属"的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助组织识别这种隐蔽的控制行为，避免被表面上的"积极管理"所迷惑。2. 为组织设计更有效的下属管理机制提供警示，避免陷入"镀金牢笼"的自我强化陷阱。3. 提出了关于这种"不可见"现象的伦理问题和未来研究方向。

title: A World Without Artificial Intelligence: Economic, Social, and Technological Consequences
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A World Without Artificial Intelligence: Economic, Social, and Technological Consequences

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NIL
declarations.ethicsApproval: No patients were involved
declarations.funderStatement: Self Funded

detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence("AI") has rapidly evolved from a specialised computational tool into a foundational layer of modern economic infrastructure. Governments, corporations, educational institutions, healthcare systems, and financial markets increasingly rely on intelligent automation for decision-making, optimisation, prediction, and operational efficiency. However, as AI systems become more deeply embedded in economic life, concerns regarding labour displacement, the concentration of wealth, democratic accountability, and long-term human dependency have intensified. This paper examines a hypothetical but increasingly relevant policy question: what would occur if individuals, corporations, or governments deliberately slowed, restricted, or abandoned large-scale AI adoption?

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了一个假设但日益相关的政策问题：如果个人、企业或政府有意减缓、限制或放弃大规模采用人工智能，将会发生什么。
AI.research_question: 如果经济主体（个人、企业或政府）有意减缓、限制或放弃大规模AI采用，会产生怎样的经济与社会后果？
AI.motivation: AI已从专业计算工具演变为现代经济基础设施的基础层，但其深度嵌入引发了劳动力替代、财富集中、民主问责和人类长期依赖等担忧，因此有必要探讨“去AI化”或“减速AI”的潜在后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文可能基于技术采用理论、制度经济学、创新扩散理论以及AI经济学相关文献构建分析框架。
AI.method: 概念性分析与政策推演，基于现有AI经济学文献和理论进行情景分析。
AI.findings: 论文指出，有意减缓或放弃AI采用可能导致经济竞争力下降、创新滞后、生产效率损失，但也可能缓解短期劳动力冲击和某些社会不平等问题，需要在技术红利与社会风险之间进行权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI经济学提供了反向视角——不是关注AI采用带来的收益，而是审视“不采用”或“减缓采用”可能产生的系统性后果，丰富了技术治理与政策选择的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、企业和个人在AI快速发展的背景下进行战略决策提供参考，帮助理解主动减速或限制AI采用可能面临的成本与收益。

title: Enterprise SBOM Governance at Scale:Lessons From AI & Automotive

detail.title: Enterprise SBOM Governance at Scale:Lessons From AI & Automotive

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, personal data, or experiments requiring institutional ethics approval. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
This whitepaper presents a practical, enterprise‑scale governance model for Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) that moves beyond static, compliance‑only generation toward continuous, policy‑driven software supply‑chain assurance. Drawing on real‑world implementations in AI platforms and safety‑critical automotive systems, it defines a full lifecycle architecture that includes automated SBOM generation, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, VEX‑driven triage, and policy‑as‑code release gating. The paper analyzes why SBOM governance remains difficult—fragmented formats, inconsistent supplier deliverables, missing integrity controls, AI/ML‑specific risks, and lack of ownership—and introduces a threat model addressing SBOM tampering, omissions, provenance failures, and model‑weight poisoning. It further maps governance controls to NIST SSDF, CISA minimum elements, and EU Cyber Resilience Act requirements.

The whitepaper provides a reference architecture, implementation RACI, KPIs/OKRs, supplier‑scoring framework, audit‑evidence patterns, and a 90‑day minimum viable program with a one‑year roadmap. By treating SBOMs as a governed data pipeline with continuous evidence, organizations can achieve scalable risk‑based decisioning, faster audit cycles, supplier trust, and regulatory‑ready assurance across complex multi‑product environments—particularly those integrating AI/ML components.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套企业级SBOM治理模型，将SBOM从静态合规工具转变为持续的政策驱动型供应链保障体系，涵盖全生命周期架构、威胁模型、合规映射及90天落地路线图。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一套企业级、可扩展的SBOM治理模型，以应对AI/ML集成环境下的软件供应链安全挑战？
AI.motivation: 现有SBOM实践停留在静态合规层面，面临格式碎片化、供应商交付不一致、完整性控制缺失、AI/ML特有风险以及权责不清等问题，亟需系统性治理框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: SBOM全生命周期治理、威胁建模（针对篡改、遗漏、溯源失败、模型权重投毒）、政策即代码、VEX驱动分类。
AI.method: 基于AI平台和汽车安全系统的真实实施案例，提出参考架构、RACI矩阵、KPI/OKR体系、供应商评分框架、审计证据模式及90天MVP路线图。
AI.findings: 将SBOM作为受治理的数据管道处理，可实现可扩展的风险决策、更快的审计周期、供应商信任以及满足NIST SSDF、CISA和欧盟网络弹性法案等监管要求的合规保障。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了针对AI/ML组件SBOM治理的威胁模型（涵盖模型权重投毒等新型风险），建立了SBOM治理与NIST SSDF、CISA、EU CRA等多框架的系统性映射。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可直接落地的90天治理启动计划、一年路线图、供应商评分机制和审计证据模式，帮助企业在复杂多产品环境中实现可操作的供应链安全保障。

title: Petroleum Inventory Trajectories Under the 2026 Strait of Hormuz Closure: A Mass-Balance Forecast Model with Sensitivity Analysis and Falsifiable Predictions
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Petroleum Inventory Trajectories Under the 2026 Strait of Hormuz Closure: A Mass-Balance Forecast Model with Sensitivity Analysis and Falsifiable Predictions

keywords: operational floor. JEL Codes: Q41 (Energy: Demand and Supply)

detail.abstract: This paper develops a weekly mass-balance forecasting model for U.S. petroleum inventories during the 2026 Strait of Hormuz closure crisis and applies it to identify the calendar dates at which Strategic Petroleum Reserve, commercial crude oil, motor gasoline, and distillate fuel oil stocks are forecast to cross their respective operational floors. Using publicly available data from the U.S. Energy Information Administration as of the week ending May 1, 2026, the model yields a base-case national motor gasoline floor crossing of July 17, 2026 (± 2 weeks under reasonable parameter perturbation), a distillate inventory level already below the operational floor as of the data cutoff, and a SPR trajectory that does not cross its political minimum within the 16-week forecast horizon at current drawdown rates. Five conditional scenarios are evaluated. Drawing on the well-established structural tightness of PADD 1 (East Coast) and PADD 5 (West Coast) relative to the national average, the paper argues that regional retail gasoline allocation events should be expected approximately 2-4 weeks in advance of national-level floor crossings, placing the most probable window for visible pump-level shortages at June 22 to July 17, 2026. Five falsifiable predictions are stated. The paper concludes by examining the price-quantity coupling that exposes domestic consumers directly to global market clearing and outlines the policy levers-export controls, accelerated SPR releases, and demand-side measures-whose invocation or non-invocation will determine the realized path.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了2026年霍尔木兹海峡危机期间美国石油库存的周度总量预测模型，识别战略石油储备、商业原油、车用汽油和馏分燃料油库存预计触及各自运营底线的日历日期，并评估了区域零售汽油短缺的时间窗口。
AI.research_question: 在2026年霍尔木兹海峡封锁危机情景下，美国各类石油库存何时会触及运营底线？区域零售汽油短缺何时出现？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治风险（霍尔木兹海峡封锁）可能严重冲击全球石油供应链，提前预测美国石油库存触及底线的时间窗口，对政策制定者和市场参与者具有重要预警意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 质量平衡预测模型（mass-balance forecasting model）；区域市场结构性紧张理论（PADD 1和PADD 5相对于全国平均水平的结构性紧张）；价格-数量耦合机制。
AI.method: 基于美国能源信息署公开数据构建周度质量平衡预测模型，进行基准情景分析及五种条件情景评估，并通过合理参数扰动进行敏感性检验（±2周）。
AI.findings: 基准情景下，全国车用汽油底线日期为2026年7月17日（±2周）；馏分燃料油库存已在数据截止日低于运营底线；战略石油储备在16周预测期内不会触及政治最低值；区域零售汽油短缺预计在2026年6月22日至7月17日出现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将质量平衡预测方法应用于地缘政治危机情景下的石油库存底线预测，并建立了全国底线与区域短缺之间的时间传导关系（2-4周领先）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了出口管制、加速SPR释放和需求侧管理等政策杠杆的决策时间参考；为市场参与者提供了可证伪的供给冲击时间预测。

title: A Bayesian-optimized physics-informed neural network for predicting ceiling smoke temperature distribution in compartment fires
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Dalian University of Technology

detail.title: A Bayesian-optimized physics-informed neural network for predicting ceiling smoke temperature distribution in compartment fires
detail.abstract: Accurately predicting the ceiling smoke temperature distribution is essential for effective fire safety design in compartment fires. This study proposes a Bayesian-optimized physics-informed neural network (BO-PINN) for predicting compartment ceiling smoke temperatures, which consists of a physics-informed neural network aided by Bayesian optimization with a Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (BO-TPE). Compared to a data-driven neural network with the same structure, the BO-PINN model maintains high prediction accuracy under sparse-data conditions. Using 1% of the training data, the BO-PINN model accurately predicts the spatio-temporal evolution of ceiling smoke temperature fields across diverse heat release rate (HRR) scenarios, achieving a coefficient of determination (R²) of 0.988. Repeated random validation demonstrates the BO-PINN model’s stability. The Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) values for the temperature field reconstructed from discrete points remained consistently above 0.92. The proposed BO-PINN model provides an accurate and physically consistent solution for the reconstruction of smoke temperature fields in compartment fires, which demonstrates the potential to contribute to fire risk assessment and safety engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种贝叶斯优化的物理信息神经网络（BO-PINN），用于在稀疏数据条件下高精度预测舱室火灾顶棚烟气温度场的时空演化，R²达0.988，SSIM持续高于0.92。
AI.research_question: 如何在稀疏数据条件下准确预测舱室火灾顶棚烟气温度分布？
AI.motivation: 准确预测顶棚烟气温度分布对火灾安全设计至关重要，但传统数据驱动模型在数据稀疏时精度不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）；贝叶斯优化（BO）；Tree-structured Parzen Estimator（TPE）
AI.method: 采用贝叶斯优化（BO-TPE）辅助的物理信息神经网络（BO-PINN），将物理约束融入神经网络训练过程，在仅用1%训练数据的条件下预测烟气温度场。
AI.findings: BO-PINN在仅用1%训练数据时R²达0.988；重复随机验证表明模型稳定性良好；温度场重建的SSIM持续高于0.92。
AI.theory_contributions: 将贝叶斯优化与物理信息神经网络相结合，解决了稀疏数据下火灾烟气温度场预测的物理一致性和精度问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为舱室火灾烟气温度场重建提供了准确且物理一致的方法，可服务于火灾风险评估与安全工程实践。

title: Does Program Duration Matter? Evidence from Girls' Education Interventions in Northern Nigeria
affiliations: Florida International University (FIU)

detail.title: Does Program Duration Matter? Evidence from Girls' Education Interventions in Northern Nigeria
detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of the Girls' Education Project Phase 3 (GEP3), a largescale girls' education programme implemented in northern Nigeria between 2012 and 2022. Using four rounds of the Nigeria Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey from 2007 to 2021 and a triple difference-indifferences design, I compare girls relative to boys, treated states relative to non-treated northern states, and post-programme periods relative to pre-programme periods. The results show that GEP3 increased girls' school attendance and improved grade progression, with substantially larger effects in states exposed to earlier programme phases. In legacy states, girls' attendance increased by 3.2 percentage points, grade-forage progression improved by 0.179 standard deviations, and dropout declined by 1.6 percentage points. Effects in newer programme states are smaller and generally imprecise. Heterogeneity estimates indicate that attendance gains are concentrated among poorer households, while reductions in dropout are strongest in legacy states with longer cumulative programme exposure. Event-study estimates are broadly consistent with the parallel trends assumption and indicate post-programme improvements in girls' schooling outcomes. The findings highlight the importance of sustained implementation and cumulative programme exposure in improving girls' educational participation and progression in low-income settings.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了尼日利亚北部大规模女童教育项目GEP3（2012-2022）的效果，发现该项目提高了女童入学率和年级 progression，且在早期实施州效果更为显著。
AI.research_question: GEP3项目对尼日利亚北部女童教育参与和学业 progression 有何影响？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚北部女童教育长期落后，存在显著的性别差距，需要严格评估大规模教育干预项目的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三重差分模型（Triple Difference-in-Differences），基于性别（女 vs 男）、地区（受干预州 vs 未受干预北部州）、时间（项目前后）的三重比较框架。
AI.method: 使用2007-2021年四轮尼日利亚多指标聚类调查（MICS）数据，采用三重差分法进行政策评估，并辅以事件研究法验证平行趋势假设。
AI.findings: 1）早期项目州女童入学率提高3.2个百分点，年级适龄进步提升0.179个标准差，辍学率下降1.6个百分点；2）新项目州效果较小且不显著；3）入学率改善集中在贫困家庭；4）辍学率下降在长期接触项目的州最强。
AI.theory_contributions: 为大规模女童教育项目在低收入环境中的长期效果提供了严谨因果证据，强调了项目持续实施和累积暴露的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚及类似低收入国家制定和优化女童教育政策提供了实证依据，指出项目实施的持续性和累积性是提升效果的关键。

title: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Regulating Human Resources

detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has emerged as a transformative force in modern Human Resource Management (HRM), significantly influencing the regulation and administration of workforce activities within organizations. This conceptual article examines the role of AI in regulating human resources by analyzing its applications in recruitment, employee performance evaluation, workforce monitoring, payroll management, training and development, employee engagement, and predictive workforce analytics. The study highlights how AI-driven technologies improve organizational efficiency, reduce human bias, enhance decision-making accuracy, and support strategic HR planning through data-driven insights. Furthermore, the article discusses the growing significance of AI in ensuring compliance, enhancing employee satisfaction, and managing remote and hybrid work environments. While AI offers numerous advantages such as automation, cost reduction, productivity enhancement, and predictive capabilities, it also raises important concerns related to privacy, ethical issues, algorithmic bias, cybersecurity, and job displacement. The article emphasizes the necessity of balancing technological innovation with human values and ethical HR practices. It concludes that AI should function as a supportive mechanism rather than a replacement for human judgment in HR regulation. The future of HRM will increasingly depend on the intelligent integration of AI systems that promote organizational sustainability, workforce development, and responsible managerial practices.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能（AI）在现代人力资源管理中的变革作用，分析了AI在招聘、绩效评估、员工监控、薪酬管理、培训发展、员工参与及预测性劳动力分析等领域的应用，强调了AI在提升效率、减少偏见、增强决策准确性方面的优势，同时指出了隐私、伦理、算法偏见、网络安全和工作替代等挑战，主张AI应作为辅助工具而非替代人类判断。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何影响现代人力资源管理中的劳动力活动监管与行政管理？
AI.motivation: AI已成为HRM中的变革性力量，但对其在人力资源监管中的具体角色、优势与挑战缺乏系统性概念梳理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以概念性分析为基础，结合AI技术应用与HRM职能（招聘、绩效、监控、薪酬、培训、员工参与、预测分析）的交叉理论。
AI.method: 概念性文章（Conceptual Article），通过文献梳理与分析构建论点。
AI.findings: AI能提升组织效率、减少人为偏见、增强决策准确性、支持战略HR规划；但也带来隐私、伦理、算法偏见、网络安全和工作替代等问题。AI应作为支持机制而非人类判断的替代品。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了AI在HRM多个职能领域的应用框架，为AI与HRM交叉研究提供了概念基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织在HR实践中平衡AI技术创新与人类价值及伦理实践提供了指导，强调了AI作为辅助工具而非替代品的定位。

title: Analyzing Carbon Removal Technology Hype Cycles Through Large Language Models
affiliations: RWTH Aachen University - RWTH Aachen University, Students and RWTH Aachen University

detail.title: Analyzing Carbon Removal Technology Hype Cycles Through Large Language Models
detail.abstract: This study examines whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can support the development of sentiment-based indicators for technological hype cycles, characterized by optimistic media language during hype phases and negative sentiment during periods of disillusionment. The rapid growth of digital news makes manual tracking of sentiment trends impractical. Traditional computational approaches relying on basic natural language processing often fail to capture context in long-form texts. LLMs offer a scalable alternative by enabling context-aware sentiment analysis across large collections of complex news articles. The study introduces an LLM-driven methodology to analyze temporal sentiment patterns in English-language news coverage over a 16-year period, focusing on carbon removal technologies. The approach extracts sentiments from major news sources and maps them over time to identify media-driven hype dynamics. This framework enables systematic analysis of technologies such as Bioenergy with Carbon Capture and Storage, afforestation/reforestation, Direct Air Capture, and ocean-based carbon capture. The key finding is that media sentiment tracking can complement other innovation indicators in the mapping of a Hype Cycle, revealing that CRT domain as a whole is heading towards a plateau of productivity.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨大语言模型（LLMs）能否用于构建基于情感的技术炒作周期指标，通过对碳去除技术（CRT）领域16年英文新闻的情感分析，发现媒体情感追踪可作为创新指标的补充，揭示CRT领域整体正走向生产力成熟期。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型能否支持构建基于情感的技术炒作周期指标，即通过分析媒体情感趋势来识别技术发展的炒作阶段与幻灭阶段？
AI.motivation: 数字新闻快速增长使得人工追踪情感趋势不切实际，传统自然语言处理方法难以捕捉长文本中的语境信息，因此需要一种可扩展且具备语境感知能力的替代方案来系统分析技术炒作周期中的媒体情感变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术炒作周期理论（Hype Cycle），该理论认为技术发展会经历"炒作期"（媒体乐观语言）和"幻灭期"（负面情感）等阶段。
AI.method: 提出一种LLM驱动的方法论，对16年期间（2007-2023年）主要英文新闻源中关于碳去除技术的文章进行语境感知的情感分析，将情感随时间映射以识别媒体驱动的炒作动态。分析对象包括BECCS、造林/再造林、DAC和海洋碳捕获等碳去除技术。
AI.findings: 媒体情感追踪可以补充其他创新指标来映射技术炒作周期；碳去除技术（CRT）领域作为一个整体正朝着生产力成熟期（Plateau of Productivity）迈进。
AI.theory_contributions: 将LLM引入技术炒作周期研究，提供了一种可扩展的、语境感知的情感分析方法来替代传统自然语言处理；实证证明了媒体情感追踪可作为技术炒作周期映射的有效补充指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、投资者和技术分析师提供了一种系统监测技术发展情感趋势的工具，帮助识别技术是否处于炒作阶段或走向成熟，从而辅助决策。

title: A multi-timescale closed-loop scheduling framework for industrial park energy systems considering state evolution of energy storage and energy-intensive loads
affiliations: Inner Mongolia University of Technology, Inner Mongolia University of Technology, Inner Mongolia University of Technology, Inner Mongolia University of Technology, Inner Mongolia University of Technology, Inner Mongolia University of Technology and Inner Mongolia University of Technology

detail.title: A multi-timescale closed-loop scheduling framework for industrial park energy systems considering state evolution of energy storage and energy-intensive loads
detail.abstract: High energy-intensive industrial parks dominated by electrolytic aluminum production are gradually transitioning toward low-carbon energy systems with high renewable penetration. In this process, conventional intra-day model predictive scheduling methods often fail to account for execution deviations in practical operation, thereby causing cumulative mismatches in the state of charge (SOC) of energy storage systems and electrolytic cell temperature. To address this issue, this paper proposes a closed-loop coordinated scheduling framework across multiple time scales. An execution-layer model is introduced to analyze the mismatch mechanisms between the planning and execution layers for both energy storage systems and electrolytic aluminum processes. A state deviation propagation model is subsequently established. Based on the SOC and electrolytic cell temperature states, a dual-state-feedback rolling correction mechanism is then developed to suppress state deviation propagation, and its effectiveness is theoretically validated. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method effectively improves SOC tracking accuracy and electrolytic cell temperature regulation in the presence of forecasting errors and model uncertainty. In addition, cumulative state drift is mitigated, leading to enhanced operational stability.

AI.tldr: 本文针对高能耗电解铝工业园区在低碳转型中存在的日内模型预测调度执行偏差问题，提出了多时间尺度闭环协调调度框架，通过引入执行层模型分析储能SOC和电解槽温的失配机理，建立状态偏差传播模型，并设计双状态反馈滚动修正机制，有效抑制了状态漂移，提升了运行稳定性。
AI.research_question: 如何解决电解铝工业园区高比例可再生能源系统中，日内模型预测调度因执行偏差导致的储能SOC和电解槽温度累积失配问题？
AI.motivation: 高能耗工业园区向低碳能源系统转型中，传统日内模型预测调度方法无法考虑实际运行中的执行偏差，导致储能SOC和电解槽温度出现累积性失配，影响系统运行稳定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多时间尺度闭环协调调度框架；执行层模型与规划层模型的失配机理分析；状态偏差传播模型；双状态反馈滚动修正机制。
AI.method: 提出多时间尺度闭环协调调度框架；引入执行层模型分析失配机理；建立状态偏差传播模型；设计基于SOC和电解槽温度的双状态反馈滚动修正机制；通过仿真验证方法有效性。
AI.findings: 所提方法在存在预测误差和模型不确定性的情况下，有效提升了SOC跟踪精度和电解槽温度调节效果，抑制了累积状态漂移，增强了运行稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了储能系统和电解铝过程中规划层与执行层之间的状态偏差传播机理；从理论上验证了双状态反馈滚动修正机制抑制状态偏差传播的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高能耗电解铝工业园区向高比例可再生能源低碳转型提供了可操作的闭环调度方案，提升了实际运行中储能管理和温度控制的可靠性。

title: Hybrid optimization for integration of renewable energy systems into smart grids
affiliations: Bahauddin Zakariya University

detail.title: Hybrid optimization for integration of renewable energy systems into smart grids
detail.abstract: Due to the substantial growth in human beings, daily consumption of energy is rising. Increasing electricity production to keep up with population increase is one strategy, albeit it is usually almost unattainable. Electricity usage and related costs may be decreased by managing demand. In order to lower energy consumption, we use Demand-side Monitoring (DSM) to schedule various devices on loads. Two important functions of the smart grid are lowering energy prices and integrating energy from renewable sources. To address the optimisation challenges, we propose a hybrid swarm-driven Harris Hawks' optimisation (S–HHO) technique. The recommended strategy offers a wide range of options for both homes and businesses. The suggested method was contrasted with wind-driven optimisation (WDO), multiple-objective genetic algorithm (MOGA), bilateral particle swarm optimisation (BPSO), and multi-objective particle swarm optimisation (MOPSO). TheMATLAB program was used to generate simulation outcomes. The findings demonstrate that compared to other techniques, such as WDO, BPSO, MOPSO, and MOGA, the enhanced hybrid optimisation technique S–HHO lowers the peak-to-average ratio (PAR) and computation time more effectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合蜂群驱动的哈里斯鹰优化算法（S-HHO），用于智能电网需求侧管理，通过优化设备调度来降低峰值平均功率比（PAR）和计算时间，从而实现节能减排。
AI.research_question: 如何通过优化算法有效降低智能电网中的峰值平均功率比（PAR）和计算时间，以实现需求侧管理？
AI.motivation: 人口增长导致电力消耗持续上升，单纯增加发电量难以实现，因此需要通过需求侧管理来降低用电成本和提高能源利用效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 需求侧管理（DSM）、智能电网、混合蜂群驱动的哈里斯鹰优化算法（S-HHO）
AI.method: 提出混合蜂群驱动的哈里斯鹰优化算法（S-HHO），并与WDO、MOGA、BPSO、MOPSO等算法进行对比，使用MATLAB进行仿真模拟。
AI.findings: S-HHO算法在降低峰值平均功率比（PAR）和减少计算时间方面优于WDO、BPSO、MOPSO和MOGA等其他优化算法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种新的混合优化算法S-HHO，将蜂群算法与哈里斯鹰优化算法结合，拓展了智能电网需求侧管理的优化方法体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为家庭和企业提供了更有效的电力调度方案，有助于降低用电成本、减少能源消耗，并促进可再生能源的整合利用。

title: Adaptive Energy Stations for Sustainable Transport Infrastructure: Real-Time Dispatch Optimization Using Marginal Grid Emissions and Low-Carbon Fuel Pathways
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Adaptive Energy Stations for Sustainable Transport Infrastructure: Real-Time Dispatch Optimization Using Marginal Grid Emissions and Low-Carbon Fuel Pathways
detail.abstract: Transport decarbonization requires not only low-carbon vehicle technologies but also infrastructure capable of selecting the lowest-emission energy pathway in real time. This study introduces Adaptive Energy Stations (AES), multi-fuel transport-energy nodes that integrate marginal grid-emission signals, fuel life-cycle carbon intensities, wholesale electricity prices, and vehicle operating constraints into a station-level dispatch optimization. A proof-of-method implementation is demonstrated for the California Independent System Operator (CAISO) zone using 168 hourly service events over 1--8 January 2026, combining WattTime marginal operating emissions, CAISO locational marginal prices, eGRID CAMX annual-average factors, and declared vehicle and fuel-pathway parameters. For plug-in hybrid electric vehicles (PHEVs), AES dispatch reduced mean emissions from 145 to 90~\gcoeqkm{} --- a 38\% improvement over a static annual-average baseline --- by shifting electric charging toward low-carbon grid intervals and substituting cellulosic E85 during high-carbon periods. Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation (10,000 draws) established practical equivalence between CAISO-zone battery electric vehicle (BEV) and cellulosic E85 pathways under a $\pm 25$~\gcoeqkm{} margin, though equivalence failed at $\pm 10$~\gcoeqkm{}. Sensitivity analyses for ERCOT, MISO--MROW, and ISO--NE extension zones revealed region-dependent emission rankings, with BEV advantages diminishing under higher grid carbon intensity. The framework supports performance-based, technology-neutral decarbonization policy by demonstrating that operational life-cycle carbon information materially alters station-level energy-pathway selection. Full deployment requires validated marginal-emission access, supply-chain verification, user-behavior characterization, and cybersecurity safeguards.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应能源站（AES）概念，通过实时整合电网边际排放信号、燃料生命周期碳强度、电价及车辆运行约束，在站点层面优化多燃料路径选择。以加州独立系统运营区（CAISO）为例的验证显示，AES可将插电式混合动力车（PHEV）的平均排放从145降至90 gCO₂eq/km（改进38%），并揭示了不同区域电网碳强度下电动与生物燃料路径的排放等效性条件。
AI.research_question: 如何通过实时基础设施层面的智能调度，选择最低排放的交通能源路径，以实现交通脱碳？
AI.motivation: 现有交通脱碳研究多聚焦于低排放车辆技术，但缺乏能够实时选择最低碳排放能源路径的基础设施。电网碳排放强度随时间动态变化，而传统静态年均碳排放因子无法捕捉这种时间异质性，导致次优的能源路径选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期碳核算、电网边际排放定价、多能源路径优化调度、不确定性传播分析（蒙特卡洛模拟）
AI.method: 构建自适应能源站（AES）优化调度模型，整合WattTime边际运行排放数据、CAISO节点边际电价、eGRID年均排放因子及车辆/燃料路径参数；以168小时服务事件（2026年1月1-8日）进行验证；通过10,000次蒙特卡洛模拟进行不确定性分析；在ERCOT、MISO-MROW、ISO-NE扩展区进行敏感性分析。
AI.findings: （1）AES使PHEV排放从145降至90 gCO₂eq/km（改进38%）；（2）在CAISO区，BEV与纤维素E85在±25 gCO₂eq/km范围内具有实际等效性，但在±10 gCO₂eq/km下不成立；（3）区域敏感性分析显示排放排名具有区域依赖性，高电网碳强度地区BEV优势减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将边际电网排放信号实时纳入交通能源基础设施调度的理论框架，证明了运营层面的生命周期碳信息能够实质性改变站点级能源路径选择，为交通脱碳研究提供了从车辆技术转向基础设施智能调度的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为性能导向、技术中立的脱碳政策提供支撑工具；为AES实际部署提出必要条件（边际排放数据接入、供应链验证、用户行为刻画、网络安全保障）；揭示了不同电网区域应因地制宜选择脱碳能源路径。

title: How Investor Position Influences Innovation: A Complex Network Perspective
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Southwest Jiaotong University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: How Investor Position Influences Innovation: A Complex Network Perspective
detail.abstract: This study empirically examines the impact pathways of investors' network positions on corporate innovation from a micro-level perspective. Findings reveal the following: First, an investor's centrality position within the network significantly and positively influences the patent output of its portfolio firms. Second, the impact of network position on innovation collaboration strategies is more complex: an investor's proactive outward connections actually inhibit the breadth and depth of corporate innovation. More critically, the reputation and activity level of an investor's direct neighbors also exert a significant negative influence on the breadth and depth of corporate collaboration, revealing that high-quality partners may trigger relationship lock-in effects. Third, the breadth and depth of innovation collaboration serve as key mediating channels through which network position influences innovation output, with the mediating effect of collaboration depth being particularly crucial. Fourth, these mechanisms are moderated by internal and external contextual factors: the heterogeneity of joint investment teams significantly amplifies the innovation returns from network position advantages, while a favorable market environment weakens the effectiveness of proactive connection strategies. Further causal analysis indicates that macro-level innovation policies significantly enhance innovation output, but their impact primarily relies on direct empowerment rather than restructuring collaborative networks.

AI.tldr: 本研究从微观视角实证考察了投资者网络位置对企业创新的影响路径。发现投资者网络中心性正向促进企业专利产出，但主动向外连接反而抑制创新合作的广度与深度；高质量邻居会引发关系锁定效应；合作深度是关键的传导中介；联合投资团队异质性放大网络优势效应，而良好市场环境削弱主动连接策略的效果；宏观创新政策主要通过直接赋能而非重构协作网络来提升创新产出。
AI.research_question: 投资者网络位置如何影响企业创新？其影响路径、中介机制和调节因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注宏观政策或企业自身特征对创新的影响，缺乏从投资者网络微观结构视角分析企业创新路径的实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会网络理论（网络位置与资源获取）、创新协作理论（合作广度与深度）、关系锁定效应（高质量伙伴的负面效应）
AI.method: 大样本实证分析，包括中介效应检验、调节效应分析及因果推断（宏观政策效果的分解分析）
AI.findings: (1) 投资者网络中心性正向促进企业专利产出；(2) 主动向外连接抑制创新合作广度与深度；(3) 高质量邻居引发关系锁定，负面影响合作广度与深度；(4) 合作深度是更关键的中介渠道；(5) 联合投资团队异质性正向调节网络优势，市场环境负向调节主动连接策略；(6) 宏观创新政策通过直接赋能而非重构网络发挥作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了投资者网络位置影响企业创新的"网络优势—协作策略—创新产出"双路径模型，揭示了关系锁定效应的微观机制，区分了合作广度与深度的不同中介作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业选择投资者提供网络位置维度的参考；提示政策制定者需关注直接赋能与网络重构的差异化效果；为投资者优化投资组合协作策略提供实证依据。

title: An interpretable few-shot load forecasting framework integrating feature interaction modeling and adaptive transfer learning
affiliations: Anhui Jianzhu University, Anhui Jianzhu University and Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics

detail.title: An interpretable few-shot load forecasting framework integrating feature interaction modeling and adaptive transfer learning
detail.abstract: Under limited sample availability in the target region, conventional forecasting methods often struggle to fully capture complex interactions among multiple influencing factors, which hard to achieve high forecasting accuracy, and also face challenges in providing transparent explanations of the prediction process. Therefore, developing an effective method that simultaneously ensures forecasting accuracy, generalization capability, and model interpretability has become a critical issue in the fields of energy and power grid operation. To address this challenge, this study proposes a novel forecasting framework that integrates temporal feature interaction modeling, an adaptive transfer learning strategy, and explainable analysis, aiming to improve cross-regional load forecasting performance under few-shot conditions and provide transparent analytical support for power grid dispatch and management. Specifically, a feature selection algorithm is first employed to identify key explanatory variables, after which a PatchTST-STAR-BIGRU model based on feature interaction modeling is constructed. Furthermore, an adaptive transfer learning strategy based on the firefly algorithm is introduced to optimize the freezing and fine-tuning schemes across different encoding layers of the model. The experimental results show that the proposed model outperforms several benchmark models and achieves superior predictive performance using only a small number of target-domain samples. The Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) and the coefficient of determination (R²) reached 1.43% and 0.98, respectively. The model also demonstrated good stability and generalization ability in cross-seasonal testing. Finally, this study employs Shapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to interpret the contributions of key features and their interactions. The results revealed the dynamic influence mechanisms of historical load, electricity prices, and meteorological factors across different seasons. This further provides interpretable decision support for power system dispatch, operation, and demand-side management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种集成时序特征交互建模、自适应迁移学习和可解释分析的新型预测框架，解决了小样本条件下的跨区域负荷预测难题，在仅使用少量目标域样本的情况下取得了1.43%的MAPE和0.98的R²，并通过SHAP揭示了关键特征在不同季节的动态影响机制。
AI.research_question: 如何在小样本条件下同时保证跨区域负荷预测的准确性、泛化能力和模型可解释性？
AI.motivation: 传统预测方法在小样本条件下难以捕捉多因素复杂交互作用、预测精度不高，且缺乏透明的预测过程解释。因此亟需开发一种兼顾准确性、泛化能力和可解释性的有效方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 特征交互建模（PatchTST-STAR-BIGRU）、自适应迁移学习（基于萤火虫算法的冻结与微调策略）、可解释性分析（SHAP）。
AI.method: 首先使用特征选择算法筛选关键解释变量，然后构建基于特征交互建模的PatchTST-STAR-BIGRU模型，再引入基于萤火虫算法的自适应迁移学习策略优化不同编码层的冻结与微调方案，最后采用SHAP进行可解释性分析。
AI.findings: 所提模型在仅使用少量目标域样本时优于多个基准模型，MAPE达1.43%，R²达0.98；在跨季节测试中展现出良好的稳定性和泛化能力；SHAP分析揭示了历史负荷、电价和气象因素在不同季节的动态影响机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了PatchTST-STAR-BIGRU特征交互建模框架；设计了基于萤火虫算法的自适应迁移学习策略，优化了跨区域知识迁移的冻结与微调方案；提供了小样本条件下跨区域负荷预测的整合方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电力系统调度运行和需求侧管理提供了高精度且可解释的决策支持；通过SHAP分析揭示了不同季节关键特征影响机制，为电网运营管理提供了透明分析依据。

title: Peer Effects in Active Learning
affiliations: Mackenzie Presbyterian University, Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) - Sao Paulo School of Economics and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Peer Effects in Active Learning
detail.abstract: This paper studies peer effects in higher education using an active learning environment where peer interaction is central to instruction. We exploit random assignment of students to tutorial groups, which generates exogenous variation in two dimensions: the ability composition of each group and the number of groups that pairs of students share. We show that both dimensions predict social proximity among peers — pairs who shared more groups and pairs closer in predetermined ability are more likely to interact, a pattern we term social proximity. We then compare outcomes under different social proximity regimes induced by this variation. Among low-ability students, a shift from the 25th to the 75th percentile in the number of peers likely to become socially proximate raises exam scores by 6.2\% per discipline, and increases the probability of an outstanding participation grade by 31 percentage points, which we interpret as evidence of increased effort. There are no detectable effects of social proximity on high-ability students. The conventional ability peer effects regression, which does not distinguish between peers likely and unlikely to become socially proximate, yields a near-zero aggregate estimate. Our results show that peer effects in higher education operate through distinct channels depending on students' ability level, and that policies targeting low-ability students must account for the social proximity that a given group composition actually generates.

AI.tldr: 本文利用随机分配学生到辅导小组的自然实验，发现同伴效应通过"社会亲近性"渠道发挥作用：低能力学生与能力相近的同伴共享更多小组时，社会互动增加，考试成绩提升6.2%，参与表现提升31个百分点；而传统回归方法因未区分社会亲近性，得出近零的聚合估计。
AI.research_question: 在高等教育中，同伴效应如何通过社会亲近性（social proximity）渠道影响不同能力水平学生的学业表现？
AI.motivation: 传统同伴效应研究通常将同组学生视为同质，忽略实际社会互动（社会亲近性）的差异，导致估计结果偏误。论文希望揭示同伴效应的作用机制——区分"可能成为社会亲近同伴"与"不太可能成为社会亲近同伴"的两类同伴。
AI.theoretical_framework: 同伴效应理论；社会亲近性（social proximity）——共享小组数量越多、能力越相近的学生之间越容易产生社会互动；能力异质性影响。
AI.method: 利用学生随机分配到辅导小组的自然实验，产生外生变异：（1）每个小组的能力构成；（2）学生之间共享小组的数量。通过这两种维度预测社会亲近性，进而比较不同社会亲近性制度下的学业结果。
AI.findings: （1）共享小组越多、能力越相近的学生之间社会互动越多（社会亲近性成立）；（2）低能力学生：社会亲近性从25分位升至75分位，考试分数提高6.2%，优秀参与分概率提高31个百分点；（3）高能力学生：无显著效应；（4）传统不加区分的同伴效应回归得出近零的聚合估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了同伴效应的异质性机制：同伴效应通过社会亲近性渠道发挥作用，且对高、低能力学生影响不同；解释了为何传统聚合估计可能掩盖真实的同伴效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高等教育分组教学（如辅导小组、学习小组）提供政策启示：针对低能力学生的政策须考虑分组构成实际产生的社会亲近性，而非仅关注能力组合的表面特征。

title: DPI ODA as a Conditional Vanguard: Evidence on Trade and FDI from Korea
affiliations: , Korea University and Korea University

detail.title: DPI ODA as a Conditional Vanguard: Evidence on Trade and FDI from Korea

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research was supported by the UNDP Seoul Policy Centre and the Development Futures Lab (DFL), affiliated with the Graduate School of International Studies at Korea University. We thank Professor Cuz Potter for his guidance and support. The views expressed in this paper are solely those of the authors and do not necessarily reflect those of the UNDP Seoul Policy Centre, Korea University, or any affiliated institutions. Any remaining errors are our own.
declarations.funderStatement: UNDP Seoul Policy Centre

detail.abstract: This study analyzes the conditional relationship between Korea’s Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) Official Development Assistance (ODA) and Korea’s bilateral commercial linkages—exports, imports, and outward FDI—using country-year panel data covering 146 recipient countries from 1987 to 2024. We identify 5,523 DPI-related projects from 83,083 OECD CRS projects through LLM-based text classification and construct a novel country-year DPI ODA panel variable. Using PPML estimation with country and year fixed effects, we document three main patterns. First, DPI ODA is positively associated with Korea’s exports and outward FDI with a time lag, while no consistent relationship appears in imports. This asymmetric pattern contrasts with lead-value tests in which all three channels are significant, suggesting a directional commercial spillover not easily explained by a purely symmetric strategic allocation story. Second, the relationship is conditionally stronger in recipient countries with higher digital readiness, measured by internet users, and stronger logistics performance, measured by the Logistics Performance Index, whereas broad governance indicators do not operate as significant conditional channels. Third, we find evidence of a post-2015 structural break in the FDI channel, consistent with a substantive change in Korea’s DPI ODA–commercial linkage structure following the strengthening of Korea’s DPI ODA policy. These findings suggest that DPI ODA may reduce transaction execution costs for donor-country firms, generating asymmetric and conditionally amplified commercial spillovers through recipient-country execution infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1987-2024年146个受援国的面板数据，通过LLM文本分类识别出5,523个韩国DPI ODA项目，发现韩国数字公共基础设施官方发展援助与出口和对外直接投资存在正向滞后关联，且在数字准备度和物流绩效较高的国家效应更强，2015年后FDI渠道出现结构性变化。
AI.research_question: 韩国数字公共基础设施官方发展援助（DPI ODA）与韩国双边商业联系（出口、进口、对外直接投资）之间存在怎样的条件性关系？
AI.motivation: 已有研究较少关注DPI ODA的商业溢出效应，且缺乏对韩国此类援助的实证分析。本文旨在揭示援助与商业联系之间的因果方向、条件异质性和结构性变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交易执行成本理论：DPI ODA通过降低受援国数字基础设施门槛，减少韩国企业在当地交易执行成本，从而产生不对称的商业溢出效应。
AI.method: 利用LLM文本分类从OECD CRS项目中识别DPI ODA项目；构建国家-年份面板数据；采用PPML估计方法，控制国家和年份固定效应；进行领先-滞后检验和结构性断点分析。
AI.findings: ①DPI ODA与出口和FDI存在滞后正相关，与进口无一致关系，呈现不对称模式；②领先值检验中三个渠道均显著，排除纯对称战略分配解释；③在互联网用户多、物流绩效高的受援国，商业溢出效应更强；④治理指标不作为显著条件渠道；⑤2015年后FDI渠道出现结构性断点。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了DPI ODA通过降低交易执行成本产生不对称商业溢出的理论机制，丰富了发展援助与商业联系关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国及其他援助国制定DPI ODA政策提供了实证依据，表明援助应在数字基础设施和物流条件较好的国家发挥更大商业协同效应，并提示政策调整（如2015年后）对商业联系的影响。

title: Market integration and nutrition security: The impact of inter-provincial trade costs on healthy diet affordability in China
affiliations: China Agricultural University, China Agricultural University and China Agricultural University

detail.title: Market integration and nutrition security: The impact of inter-provincial trade costs on healthy diet affordability in China
detail.abstract: China's agricultural markets remain fragmented, with intra-provincial trade dominating cross-regional food flows. We argue that high inter-provincial trade costs undermine market integration, thereby reducing supply chain resilience and food availability—ultimately making healthy diets more expensive. Using a gravity model to measure trade costs and linear programming to estimate the cost of a healthy diet (CoHD) over 2011–2023, a two-way fixed effects model confirms that trade barriers significantly raise the CoHD, with the strongest effects in primary marketing regions and eastern provinces. These findings suggest that reducing domestic trade frictions can improve diet affordability and nutrition security, with broader implications for market integration policies in developing economies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现中国省际贸易壁垒会显著提高健康膳食成本，尤其是在主销区和东部省份，降低贸易摩擦有助于改善膳食可负担性和营养安全。
AI.research_question: 省际贸易壁垒如何影响中国健康膳食成本（CoHD）？
AI.motivation: 中国农产品市场仍然碎片化，省内贸易主导跨区域食品流动，这可能削弱供应链韧性、减少食物可获得性，并使健康膳食更加昂贵。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易成本理论、市场整合理论；使用引力模型衡量贸易成本，线性规划估算健康膳食成本。
AI.method: 引力模型（测算贸易成本）+ 线性规划（估算2011-2023年健康膳食成本CoHD）+ 双向固定效应模型（检验贸易壁垒对CoHD的影响）。
AI.findings: 贸易壁垒显著提高了健康膳食成本，该效应在主销区和东部省份最为强烈。
AI.theory_contributions: 将国内贸易成本与膳食 affordability 联系起来，拓展了市场整合与营养安全交叉领域的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家降低国内贸易摩擦、改善膳食可负担性和营养安全提供政策启示。

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on theoretical analysis, secondary statistical data, and existing academic literature related to digital trade and economic development. It did not involve human participants, surveys, interviews, or personal data collection requiring ethical approval. Therefore, formal ethics committee approval was not necessary for this research.

detail.abstract: Digitalization has fundamentally reshaped the architecture of global trade. Unlike previous waves of globalization driven by industrial capacity and physical infrastructure, the current transformation is powered by data, platforms, and digital connectivity (Ahmadova & Mammadov, 2025b; UNCTAD, 2021). For developing countries, digital trade presents both an unprecedented opportunity and a structural challenge. This paper examines the relationship between digital trade and economic development, focusing on productivity growth, export diversification, labor market transformation, financial inclusion, and institutional adaptation. It argues that digital trade can become a strategic development tool, but only if supported by coherent policy frameworks, infrastructure investment, and human capital development (Mammadov et al., 2026; World Bank, 2022). Without such foundations, digital integration may reinforce inequalities rather than reduce them.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨数字贸易与发展中国家经济发展的关系，指出数字贸易虽能提升生产率、促进出口多样化、推动金融包容性，但若无政策支持、基础设施和人力资本配套，可能加剧不平等。
AI.research_question: 数字贸易如何影响发展中国家的经济发展？
AI.motivation: 数字化深刻重塑全球贸易格局，发展中国家面临机遇与结构性挑战并存，需系统审视数字贸易对经济发展的多维影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际贸易理论、数字经济学、发展经济学
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析
AI.findings: 数字贸易可促进生产率增长、出口多样化、劳动力市场转型、金融包容性和制度适应，但需政策、基础设施和人力资本支撑，否则可能加剧不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理数字贸易对发展中国家经济发展多维影响的理论机制，提出数字贸易作为发展工具的条件性框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家制定数字贸易政策提供参考，强调基础设施投资、人力资本建设和制度配套的重要性。
