detail.abstract: This paper examines the performance characteristics of multi-scale signal decomposition frameworks applied to market-neutral equity portfolio construction. We demonstrate that ensembling conviction signals across multiple temporal scales produces systematically superior risk-adjusted returns compared to any single-timeframe approach. Using a pointin-time S&P 500 universe over the period March 2022 through May 2026 (1,045 trading days), we construct a 30-long / 30-short equal-weight portfolio rebalanced every three trading days. The multi-scale framework achieves an annualized Sharpe ratio of 2.68 (conservative, 10 bps flat transaction cost) with CAGR of 27.3% and maximum drawdown of-4.1%, compared to single-scale variants that range from 0.74 to 1.52 Sharpe. Walkforward validation shows out-of-sample Sharpe of 3.96 exceeding in-sample Sharpe of 2.11 (OOS/IS ratio of 1.88). Parameter perturbation analysis yields a coefficient of variation of 0.037 across eighteen configurations, with a Deflated Sharpe Ratio exceeding the multipletesting threshold by 2.7×. The strategy generates positive alpha in 6 of 7 major market stress events within the evaluation period.

AI.tldr: 本文证明多尺度信号分解框架构建的市场中性投资组合，其风险调整后收益显著优于任何单一时间尺度方法，样本外夏普比率达3.96，最大回撤仅-4.1%。
AI.research_question: 多尺度信号分解框架相比单一时间尺度方法，在构建市场中性股票投资组合时是否能产生更优的风险调整后收益？
AI.motivation: 传统量化投资多使用单一时间尺度的信号，但金融市场本身具有多尺度特征，单一视角可能错失跨时间维度的信息整合效应。本文旨在系统性地验证多尺度集成框架对市场中性策略的改进效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多尺度信号分解理论、市场中性投资组合理论、集成学习（Ensemble）思想、Deflated Sharpe Ratio多重检验校正理论。
AI.method: 采用多尺度信号分解集成框架，在S&P 500成分股范围内（2022年3月至2026年5月，共1,045个交易日），构建30多/30空等权组合，每三个交易日再平衡。通过Walk-forward验证和参数扰动分析评估稳健性。
AI.findings: 多尺度框架年化夏普比率2.68（保守假设10bps交易成本），年化收益率27.3%，最大回撤仅-4.1%；单一尺度夏普比率范围为0.74-1.52。样本外夏普3.96超过样本内2.11，OOS/IS比1.88。18种参数配置变异系数仅0.037，Deflated Sharpe Ratio超多重检验阈值2.7倍。在7次重大市场压力事件中6次产生正Alpha。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地建立了多尺度信号集成与市场中性策略收益的理论联系，提出了跨时间维度信号融合的量化框架，为金融时间序列的多分辨率分析提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可落地的多尺度市场中性策略构建方案，给出了明确的参数稳健性证据和压力测试表现，对量化投资实务具有直接参考价值。

title: A Block-Coordinate Homotopy Method for Multi-Region DSGE Models with Occasionally Binding Constraints

detail.title: A Block-Coordinate Homotopy Method for Multi-Region DSGE Models with Occasionally Binding Constraints
detail.abstract: This paper develops a block-coordinate homotopy method for computingMarkov perfect equilibria in multi-region DSGE models with occasionallybinding constraints (OBCs). The algorithm decomposes the equilibrium sys-tem into region-specific subproblems solved via semismooth Newton con-tinuation. We prove convergence under a state-dependent coupling bound,establish an O(m^2) theoretical per-iteration flop-count reduction relative tostandard policy function iteration, and verify uniform grid convergence. Ona synthetic 4-region carbon-taxation model the solver handles 98.7% bindingconstraints, converges at 30× the theoretical coupling bound, and achievesmachine-precision accuracy against closed-form LQ solutions. A carbon-policy counterfactual demonstrates that exact OBC projection changes quan-titative policy conclusions: smooth log-barrier approximations understate thewelfare gain from coordinated tax differentiation by 0.46 percentage points—comparable to the estimated loss from unilateral leakage (−1.79%).

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种块坐标同伦方法，用于计算多区域DSGE模型中偶尔受约束的马尔可夫完美均衡，通过区域子问题分解和半光滑牛顿连续法求解，在合成4区域碳税模型中实现了98.7%的约束处理能力，并发现精确投影会改变定量政策结论。
AI.research_question: 如何高效计算多区域DSGE模型中带有偶尔约束的马尔可夫完美均衡？
AI.motivation: 多区域DSGE模型中的偶尔约束问题计算复杂度高，现有方法难以高效求解，而精确处理这些约束对政策评估至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 块坐标同伦方法、半光滑牛顿连续法、马尔可夫完美均衡、偶尔约束（OBCs）
AI.method: 将均衡系统分解为区域特定子问题，通过半光滑牛顿连续法求解；证明状态依赖耦合边界下的收敛性，建立理论每迭代浮点运算次数降低至O(m²)的分析。
AI.findings: 合成4区域碳税模型中：处理98.7%的约束；在理论耦合边界30倍条件下收敛；达到机器精度水平的准确性；精确投影相比光滑对数障碍近似，协调税收差异化的福利增益被低估0.46个百分点，相当于单边泄漏估计损失（-1.79%）的相当规模。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了多区域DSGE中OBC问题的高效计算框架，证明了状态依赖耦合边界下的收敛性，建立了理论计算复杂度分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为碳税政策评估提供了精确计算工具，揭示了近似方法对政策结论的实质性偏差，对多区域气候政策设计具有指导意义。

title: A Unified Calibration Framework and Synthesis Methodology for High Dynamic Range Imaging with Complementary Vision Sensors
affiliations: Xiamen University, Tsinghua University and Tsinghua University

detail.title: A Unified Calibration Framework and Synthesis Methodology for High Dynamic Range Imaging with Complementary Vision Sensors
detail.abstract: Acquiring high-quality visual data in unconstrained environments remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision, primarily because conventional cameras often produce over- or under-exposed images under extreme illumination. Unlike traditional high dynamic range (HDR) sensors, which rely on homogeneous pixels with uniform full-well capacities and noise floors, brain-inspired complementary vision sensors such as Tianmouc offer an alternative approach with heterogeneous pixels. These sensors achieve HDR by fusing information from two interleaved data pathways: a frame-based RGB pathway and an action-oriented pathway that captures sparse, high-speed spatiotemporal differences. However, these sensors lack a systematic method for defining and measuring their dynamic range to establish performance boundaries, as well as a suitable HDR synthesis technique to fully exploit their data fusion potential. To address this gap, we extend the EMVA 1288 standard to develop a rigorous calibration methodology that quantifies performance variations across different exposure combinations of the multi-pathway data. Anchored by these physical measurements, we then introduce the Progressive Fusion-Alignment Network (PFANet), a novel video synthesis network designed to adaptively merge complementary exposure data streams. By incorporating physical parameters via Feature-wise Linear Modulation and ensuring robust motion alignment, our model effectively integrates the high-frequency difference data from the AOP with the absolute intensity backbone of the RGB pathway. Extensive experiments validate our framework, demonstrating remarkable real-world HDR imaging performance. The proposed approach not only preserves intricate visual details across extreme lighting variations but also significantly mitigates motion artifacts commonly associated with conventional multi-exposure fusion techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文针对脑启发互补视觉传感器（如Tianmouc）在高动态范围成像中缺乏系统校准方法和数据融合技术的问题，提出了基于EMVA 1288标准的校准方法，并设计了渐进式融合对齐网络（PFANet），有效融合RGB帧通路和动作导向通路的异构数据，在极端光照条件下实现了高质量HDR成像，显著减少了运动伪影。
AI.research_question: 如何为采用异构像素和多通路数据的脑启发互补视觉传感器（如Tianmouc）建立系统的高动态范围校准方法，并设计有效的数据融合技术以充分发挥其HDR成像潜力？
AI.motivation: 传统HDR传感器依赖均匀像素和统一满阱容量，在极端光照下表现有限。脑启发互补视觉传感器虽采用异构像素和双通路（RGB帧通路+动作导向通路）设计，但缺乏系统的动态范围定义与测量方法，以及适合的HDR合成技术来有效挖掘其数据融合潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于EMVA 1288图像传感器标准扩展的校准方法学；渐进式融合对齐网络（PFANet），利用特征级线性调制（FiLM）注入物理参数，并结合运动对齐机制，融合动作导向通路的高频差分数据与RGB通路的绝对强度信息。
AI.method: 扩展EMVA 1288标准以量化多通路数据在不同曝光组合下的性能变化；设计PFANet（渐进式融合对齐网络），通过FiLM将物理参数嵌入网络，结合运动对齐模块，自适应融合互补曝光数据流；使用真实场景数据进行实验验证。
AI.findings: 提出的校准方法能够有效量化传感器性能边界；PFANet在极端光照变化条件下能保留精细视觉细节，并显著减少传统多曝光融合技术常见的运动伪影，实现出色的真实世界HDR成像效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为脑启发互补视觉传感器的异构像素和多通路架构建立了系统的高动态范围校准方法（扩展EMVA 1288标准）；提出了针对多通路异构数据的渐进式融合对齐网络，为异构视觉传感器的数据融合提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Tianmouc类脑启发互补视觉传感器提供了可操作的性能标定方法；PFANet实现了高质量HDR视频合成，可应用于自动驾驶、安防监控等极端光照环境下的计算机视觉任务。

title: When Winners Stop Winning Simple and Weighted Market Momentum Fragility Signals for U.S. Equity Left-Tail Risk
affiliations: and

detail.title: When Winners Stop Winning Simple and Weighted Market Momentum Fragility Signals for U.S. Equity Left-Tail Risk
detail.abstract: This paper studies whether lagged market momentum spreads identify U.S. equity left-tail risk. For the Dow Jones Industrial Average, Nasdaq Composite, and S&P 500, I define 12-1 momentum as the cumulative return from months t-12 to t-2, skipping t-1. I construct two predetermined state variables: a simple quick-minus-slow signal based on simple moving averages of 12-1 momentum and a weighted version that gives greater weight to recent 12-1 momentum observations. Both signals are mechanically determined by the end of month t-2, making them early-determined, low-frequency indicators rather than daily trend-following rules. Across markets, negative and fragile states are associated with weaker returns and higher left-tail probabilities. For the S&P 500, the simple fragile state has a 20.7% probability of a monthly loss worse than-5%, versus 6.8% in the strongest state; the weighted fragile state gives a similar 20.4% probability. Moving-average filters remain stronger standalone left-tail classifiers when allowed to use more recent price information. The practical contribution is timing: QS and WQS warning episodes that contain left-tail months begin roughly three to four months before the first left-tail month on average, while the standard 12-month moving-average rule often confirms weakness in the same month. The contribution is therefore not a replacement for moving averages, but an early-determined momentum-deterioration state variable for risk budgeting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究滞后市场动量扩散是否能识别美国股市的左尾风险。通过构建简单和加权两种基于12-1动量的提前判定状态变量，发现脆弱状态与更低的回报和更高的左尾概率显著相关，且能比标准移动平均线提前3-4个月发出预警。
AI.research_question: 滞后市场动量扩散（lagged market momentum spreads）是否能有效识别美国股票市场的左尾风险（left-tail risk）？
AI.motivation: 传统移动平均线等趋势跟踪指标通常具有滞后性，确认市场弱势时往往已发生损失。作者希望构建一个提前判定的、低频的状态变量，在左尾事件实际发生前更早地识别风险积聚，为风险预算管理提供更及时的信号。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于动量扩散（momentum spreads）和移动平均线过滤器的逻辑，利用12-1动量（跳过最近一个月）构建简单快慢信号（QS）和加权快慢信号（WQS），作为提前判定的状态变量。
AI.method: 对道琼斯工业平均指数、纳斯达克综合指数和标普500指数，定义12-1动量（t-12到t-2月的累计回报，跳过t-1月）。构建两种状态变量：（1）简单QS信号：基于12-1动量的简单移动平均快慢差；（2）加权WQS信号：对近期12-1动量观测赋予更大权重。两种信号均在t-2月底机械确定。比较不同状态下回报率和左尾概率，并评估信号提前预警的时间长度。
AI.findings: （1）负面/脆弱状态与更低的回报和更高的左尾概率显著相关；（2）标普500中，简单脆弱状态出现月度亏损超过-5%的概率为20.7%，而最强状态仅为6.8%；加权脆弱状态为20.4%；（3）允许使用更近期价格信息时，移动平均滤波器仍是更强的左尾分类器；（4）QS和WQS的预警信号比标准12个月移动平均线提前约3-4个月，而后者往往在左尾发生的同月才确认弱势。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于动量扩散的提前判定状态变量（QS和WQS），揭示了动量结构变化与左尾风险之间的超前关系，为理解市场脆弱性的早期信号机制提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种比传统移动平均线更早识别左尾风险的实用工具，能够提前3-4个月发出预警，可用于风险预算管理中的早期风险识别和资产配置调整，而非替代现有移动平均规则。

title: Does Green Public Procurement Affect Procurement Performance? Evidence from Minimum Environmental Criteria in Italian Public Lighting Procurement
affiliations: Roma Tre University, Roma Tre University, University of Naples "L'Orientale" and Roma Tre University

detail.title: Does Green Public Procurement Affect Procurement Performance? Evidence from Minimum Environmental Criteria in Italian Public Lighting Procurement
detail.abstract: Green Public Procurement is increasingly used as a demand-side policy tool to promote environmental objectives, with theoretical predictions - rooted in the Porter hypothesis -suggesting market selection but no effect on competition plus negative effects in terms of administrative burden. This paper examines the impact of Green Public Procurement on procurement performance, exploiting the introduction of Minimum Environmental Criteria in the Italian public lighting sector. Using an interrupted time series design, we find a large and statistically significant reduction in market participation. However, we detect no effect on price competition or on time to award. Overall, the results suggest that Green Public Procurement reshapes market structure without altering procurement performance.

AI.tldr: 本文利用意大利公共照明领域引入最低环境标准（CAM）的自然实验，采用中断时间序列设计，发现绿色公共采购显著减少了市场参与度，但对价格竞争和授予时间无显著影响，表明绿色公共采购重塑了市场结构但未改变采购绩效。
AI.research_question: 绿色公共采购（GPP）对采购绩效（市场参与、价格竞争、授予时间）有何影响？
AI.motivation: 绿色公共采购作为需求侧政策工具日益普及，但波特假说等理论预测其会产生市场选择效应且不损害竞争，同时存在行政负担。然而，缺乏实证证据检验这些理论预测，特别是GPP对实际采购绩效的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 波特假说（Porter hypothesis）：环境规制可以通过创新补偿效应提升竞争力，且不会损害市场竞争。
AI.method: 采用中断时间序列设计（Interrupted Time Series Design），利用意大利公共照明领域引入最低环境标准（Minimum Environmental Criteria, CAM）这一准自然实验。
AI.findings: （1）绿色公共采购显著减少了市场参与度；（2）对价格竞争无显著影响；（3）对授予时间（招标周期）无显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为波特假说提供了实证检验，证实了绿色公共采购会导致市场选择（筛选出不符合环境标准的企业），但对竞争无损害效应，部分支持了波特假说的理论预测。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了绿色公共采购实际效果的实证证据：GPP会重塑市场结构（减少投标者数量），但不会牺牲采购绩效（价格和效率），缓解了对GPP可能导致成本上升或效率下降的担忧。

title: Most seek higher earnings, some escape unemployment, but none look for a handout: Economic drivers of labor mobility in the European Union
affiliations: Lazarski University, Lazarski University, Lazarski University and Lazarski University

detail.title: Most seek higher earnings, some escape unemployment, but none look for a handout: Economic drivers of labor mobility in the European Union
detail.abstract: This study examines the economic determinants of labor mobility within the European Union using data from 23 EU member states over the period 2000–2019. To address both model uncertainty and reverse causality, we employ Bayesian model averaging within a dynamic panel framework with weakly exogenous regressors. We find strong persistence in EU migration flows, largely driven by network effects operating through migrants already present in destination countries. While both earnings and unemployment differentials influence migration, the effect of earnings is 18 to 24 times stronger, suggesting that the search for higher income dominates the motive of escaping unemployment. This finding challenges the notion that labor mobility currently serves as an effective adjustment mechanism in the EU. However, as unemployment differentials tend to widen during recessions and their aftermath, migration may still contribute to economic adjustment when it is most needed. We find no evidence that differences in social benefits, taxation, or human capital significantly affect migration flows, contradicting prior empirical findings and media narratives suggesting the existence of welfare migration. Our results highlight the importance of addressing model uncertainty and endogeneity to accurately assess the drivers of labor mobility in the European context.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2000-2019年23个欧盟成员国的数据，采用贝叶斯模型平均法和动态面板框架，发现欧盟劳动力流动主要由网络效应和收入差距驱动，收入效应远强于失业效应（18-24倍），而社会福利、税收和人力资本差异对移民流动无显著影响。
AI.research_question: 欧盟内部劳动力流动的经济决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有研究在劳动力流动的决定因素上存在模型不确定性和反向因果问题，且对福利移民等媒体叙事缺乏严谨检验。作者希望通过解决方法学问题，准确评估欧盟劳动力流动的驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力流动的经济学理论（推拉模型）、网络效应理论、福利移民假说
AI.method: 贝叶斯模型平均法（Bayesian model averaging）结合动态面板框架，处理弱外生回归变量，以应对模型不确定性和反向因果问题。数据涵盖2000-2019年23个欧盟成员国。
AI.findings: 1. 欧盟移民流动具有强持续性，主要由网络效应（已有移民存量）驱动；2. 收入和失业差异都影响移民，但收入效应比失业效应强18-24倍，说明追求更高收入是主导动机；3. 社会福利、税收、人力资本差异对移民无显著影响，否定了"福利移民"假说；4. 失业差异在经济衰退及之后时期扩大，此时移民仍可能发挥调整功能。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"劳动力流动是欧盟有效调整机制"的传统认知；否定了"福利移民"假说，为相关理论争议提供了严谨的实证证据；揭示了模型不确定性和内生性对劳动力流动研究结论的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟政策制定者提供了劳动力流动的真实驱动因素证据：应关注收入差距而非福利差异来理解移民；在经济衰退期应重视移民的潜在调整作用；反驳了"福利移民"的媒体叙事，有助于减少基于此的政策误导。

title: CBDCs and Debt management: a portfolio balance approach
affiliations: University College London and Link Campus University

detail.title: CBDCs and Debt management: a portfolio balance approach
detail.abstract: This paper presents a macro-financial model that combines the three-equation Carlin and Soskice (2018) framework with a portfolio-balance block `a la Tobin (1969) and a retail interest-bearing Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC). The work offers a new perspective on sovereign debt management in incomplete monetary unions. The portfolio-balance approach allows the model to endogenously generate fragmentation dynamics. The introduction of CBDC alters these dynamics. Importantly, CBDC’s net impact on debt management depends on CBDCs issuance design as well as on CBDC holdings. Two issuance designs are here considered: sovereign bonds’ and deposits’ conversion. In the first case, the Central Bank acts a rule-bound absorber and it creates a persistent structural floor for sovereign bonds demand. Under the deposit conversion mechanism, the improvements in debt management pass eventually through commercial banks’ carry-trade behaviour. In both cases, the cap on non-financial private sector CBDC holdings emerges as the key design parameter determining whether CBDC stabilises or amplifies fragmentation during stress episodes. Throughout, Central Bank independence is preserved. The framework is directly applicable to the Digital Euro project and the institutional architecture of the Euro area.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个结合Carlin-Soskice三方程框架与Tobin资产组合平衡模型的宏观金融模型，研究在引入零售型计息央行数字货币（CBDC）后，不完整货币联盟的主权债务管理问题。CBDC通过两种发行设计（主权债券转换和存款转换）影响债务管理，而非金融私人部门的CBDC持有上限是决定其在压力时期是稳定还是放大碎片化的关键设计参数。
AI.research_question: 在不完整货币联盟中引入零售型计息CBDC如何影响主权债务管理？CBDC的不同发行设计（债券转换与存款转换）对债务碎片化动态有何不同作用？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对CBDC在货币联盟中的宏观金融影响研究不足，尤其在主权债务管理方面缺乏系统性分析。欧元区等不完整货币联盟面临内生性碎片化风险，需要新的理论框架来评估CBDC的设计选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: Carlin和Soskice（2018）的三方程宏观框架；Tobin（1969）的资产组合平衡模型；内生碎片化动态机制；CBDC发行设计理论（债券转换与存款转换）。
AI.method: 宏观金融模型构建与理论分析。
AI.findings: 1) 资产组合平衡方法可内生生成碎片化动态；2) CBDC的引入会改变碎片化动态；3) CBDC对债务管理的净效应取决于发行设计和持有量；4) 在债券转换机制下，央行充当规则约束的"吸收者"，为主权债券需求创造持久结构性底部；5) 在存款转换机制下，改善效果通过商业银行的套利行为传导；6) 非金融私人部门CBDC持有上限是关键设计参数，决定CBDC在压力时期是稳定还是放大碎片化。
AI.theory_contributions: 将CBDC引入宏观金融模型，拓展了不完整货币联盟中主权债务管理的理论分析；通过资产组合平衡方法内生化了碎片化动态机制，为理解CBDC如何影响货币联盟稳定性提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字欧元项目及欧元区制度架构提供了可直接应用的政策指导；明确了CBDC设计参数（持有上限、发行机制）对债务管理效果的关键影响，为央行设计CBDC提供了决策参考。

detail.title: GOD MODE SOLAR SKIN DEPLOYER (GMSSD) Civilization 1 technology Continuous Clay-to-PV Ceramic Ribbon System Zero-Import | Self-Powering | Desert Electrification & Soil Stabilization Created by Kaveh Dimitri Salahi & Grok4xAI -March 2026 All Rights Reserved under Priority Arts Framework
detail.abstract: The God Mode Solar Skin Deployer is a single tracked vehicle that transforms raw desert clay and soil into a continuous ribbon of photovoltaic glass-ceramic sheeting — permanently bonded to the ground — in one uninterrupted pass.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种名为"上帝模式太阳能皮肤部署器"的单履带车辆，它能够将沙漠粘土和土壤直接转化为连续的光伏玻璃-陶瓷片，并在单次通过中永久粘合在地面上。
AI.research_question: 如何实现将沙漠土壤直接原位转化为可用的光伏材料，并以连续工艺部署在沙漠地表？
AI.motivation: 传统太阳能电池板制造和部署成本高、运输困难，尤其不适合沙漠等偏远地区。该研究旨在开发一种能够直接利用沙漠原材料、现场制造和部署光伏系统的设备。
AI.theoretical_framework: 涉及光伏材料科学（玻璃-陶瓷光伏材料）、机械工程（单履带车辆设计）、原位制造与部署工艺等跨学科理论。
AI.method: 设计并制造了一种单履带车辆，该车辆能够在行驶过程中将沙漠粘土和土壤作为原料，通过某种工艺（如高温熔融、结晶等）转化为光伏玻璃-陶瓷带状片材，并同时将其永久粘合到地面。
AI.findings: 成功实现了在单次不间断通行中，将沙漠土壤转化为连续的光伏玻璃-陶瓷片材，并永久固定在地面上。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了原位光伏材料合成与一体化部署的新概念，拓展了光伏制造与部署的边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为沙漠地区大规模、低成本太阳能开发提供了潜在的革命性技术路径，大幅降低了运输和安装成本。

title: Order of Tone, Information Transmission, and Investor Reaction: Evidence from Analyst Report Text
affiliations: Renmin University of China, Renmin University of China, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Renmin University of China

detail.title: Order of Tone, Information Transmission, and Investor Reaction: Evidence from Analyst Report Text
detail.abstract: From the perspective of information presentation order, this paper investigates how the order of textual tone shapes information transmission in capital markets. Using a sample of analyst research reports on Chinese A-share listed firms from 2009 to 2022, we find that: (1) After controlling for the overall tone of the analyst report, the priority net tone is significantly positively correlated with short-term market reactions following the report release; (2) The market reactions to the priority tone aligns with the “incremental information view,” with no evidence of long-term return reversals; (3) The priority tone of analyst reports predicts firms’ future performance, conveying incremental information about firms’ fundamental prospects; (4) The market reactions to the priority tone of analyst reports is significantly amplified when institutional ownership of the covered firms is higher, the reports are issued by star analysts, or the level of information transparency of the covered firms is lower; (5) Analysts who effectively convey incremental information early in their reports are more likely to advance their careers and be recognized as star analysts. This study reveals the critical role of information presentation order in capital market pricing and attention allocation, providing a new perspective for understanding how market participants process “first-impression information”. Moreover, it extends research on limited attention and market behavior biases, while offering new theoretical support for information disclosure and high-quality investment research.

AI.tldr: 本文从信息呈现顺序视角，研究分析师研究报告文本语调的优先级如何影响资本市场信息传递。基于2009-2022年中国A股上市公司分析师报告样本，发现报告前期净语调与短期市场反应显著正相关，且该效应符合"增量信息观"，不存在长期反转；优先级语调能预测公司未来业绩；该效应受机构持股、明星分析师、信息透明度等因素调节；有效传递增量信息的分析师更易获得职业发展。
AI.research_question: 分析师研究报告的文本语调呈现顺序如何影响资本市场信息传递？具体而言，报告前期的"优先级语调"是否以及如何影响市场反应？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注文本信息的整体语调或内容，忽视了信息呈现顺序（即"先说什么、后说什么"）对投资者注意力分配和信息处理的影响。本研究旨在填补这一空白，从"第一印象"视角揭示信息呈现顺序在资本市场定价中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限注意力理论、信息呈现顺序效应（首因效应/第一印象）、增量信息假说、市场效率理论
AI.method: 样本为2009-2022年中国A股上市公司分析师研究报告，采用文本分析方法提取报告各部分的语调，构建"优先级净语调"指标，通过多元回归分析检验其与短期市场反应（累计异常收益CAR）、长期反转、公司未来业绩预测之间的关系，并进行横截面异质性分析和分析师职业发展分析。
AI.findings: (1)控制整体语调后，优先级净语调与报告发布后短期市场反应显著正相关；(2)该效应符合"增量信息观"，无长期反转证据；(3)优先级语调可预测公司未来业绩；(4)机构持股比例高、明星分析师发布、信息透明度低时，该效应更显著；(5)有效传递增量信息的分析师更易成为明星分析师并获得职业晋升。
AI.theory_contributions: 为有限注意力理论和信息呈现顺序效应在资本市场中的应用提供了新证据；拓展了文本信息研究从"整体内容"到"顺序结构"的分析维度；揭示了"第一印象信息"在资产定价中的机制，丰富了市场行为偏差研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为信息披露监管和信息披露顺序设计提供理论支持；为投资者解读研究报告提供参考——注意报告前期的信息增量价值；为分析师职业发展路径提供启示——有效组织信息呈现顺序助力职业晋升。

title: Environmental Criteria and Clauses in Public Procurement: Theory and Evidence on their Effects on Bidder Participation
affiliations: Avignon University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Université d'Avignon

detail.title: Environmental Criteria and Clauses in Public Procurement: Theory and Evidence on their Effects on Bidder Participation
detail.abstract: Many governments around the world use public procurement as an environmental policy instrument through clauses (i.e., mandatory specifications in the contract performance) and award criteria (i.e., the dimensions of the offers the contracting authority assesses). Green clauses and criteria are often thought to discourage firm participation in procurement procedures. This article evaluates the impact of green clauses and criteria on firm participation from both theoretical and empirical perspectives. From a theoretical standpoint, we show that these instruments have a twofold effect: they may exclude some firms and raise participation costs, while also increasing firm expected margins. We test this prediction empirically using 50,000 procurement procedures in France between 2022 and 2023. We find a robust positive effect of both green clauses and criteria on participation, suggesting that the growing integration of sustainability into public procurement is unlikely to explain the observed decline in participation in procurement procedures.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论和实证角度分析绿色条款和绿色评标标准对政府采购中企业参与的影响，发现两者均能正向促进企业参与，挑战了"绿色采购抑制参与"的传统观点。
AI.research_question: 绿色采购条款和评标标准如何影响企业在政府采购程序中的参与度？
AI.motivation: 各国政府将公共采购作为环境政策工具，但绿色条款和标准常被认为会抑制企业参与。作者希望检验这一假设是否成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双重效应理论：绿色条款和标准一方面可能排挤部分企业并提高参与成本，另一方面也会提高企业的预期利润空间。
AI.method: 理论建模 + 实证分析，使用2022-2023年法国约5万份采购程序数据。
AI.findings: 绿色条款和绿色评标标准对企业的参与均有显著正向影响，表明绿色采购并非导致企业参与度下降的原因。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了绿色采购工具对企业参与的双重效应机制（排挤/成本增加 vs 预期利润提升），并提供了大样本实证证据反驳了传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了信心：将可持续性纳入公共采购不会损害竞争性，不会加剧采购参与度下降的趋势。

title: Wave-Mamba: A Dual-Stream Framework for Crack Segmentation Based on Frequency-Domain State Space Learning
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Shaanxi Normal University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Wave-Mamba: A Dual-Stream Framework for Crack Segmentation Based on Frequency-Domain State Space Learning
detail.abstract: In order to guarantee infrastructure safety, assess its state, and make maintenance easier, crack segmentation is essential. Cur rent automatic segmentation techniques must make a basic trade-off between collecting fine-grained local texture details and maintaining global topological continuity, particularly when high-frequency noise like oil stains and other surface abnormali ties are present. Additionally, Transformer-based models for global context modeling frequently have high computational com plexity, which restricts their use for real-time execution. In order to overcome these constraints, we present Wave-Mamba, a lightweight dual-stream hybrid network that improves topological consistency in crack segmentation by combining Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with State Space Models (Mamba). In order to distinguish structural topology from background noise, we specifically present a unique Frequency-Domain Structure Stream based on Haar Wavelet Downsampling. In order to im prove robustness under challenging environmental circumstances, this stream is further combined with a Frequency-Gated Fusion Module, which efficiently combines global structural information with local detail characteristics. Using three different avail able datasets—CRACK500, DeepCrack, and CrackForest—we methodically assess the suggested approach. Wave-Mamba obtains 71.62% mIoU on CRACK500, 71.53% mIoU on DeepCrack, and 52.60% mIoU on CrackForest, according to experimental data. After the research is published, the dataset and source code will be openly accessible at https://github.com/Sajawal126/ wave-mamba-pavement-crack-segmentation following the publication of the paper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Wave-Mamba，一种轻量级双流混合网络，结合CNN和状态空间模型（Mamba）用于裂缝分割，通过频域结构流和频率门控融合模块，在保持拓扑连续性的同时降低计算复杂度，在三个数据集上取得不错效果。
AI.research_question: 如何在不牺牲全局拓扑连续性的前提下，实现轻量级、实时的裂缝分割，并有效抑制高频噪声干扰？
AI.motivation: 现有裂缝分割方法需要在细粒度局部纹理细节与全局拓扑连续性之间做出权衡，尤其是在油污等高频噪声干扰下问题更为突出；同时，基于Transformer的全局上下文建模方法计算复杂度过高，难以实现实时执行。
AI.theoretical_framework: 卷积神经网络（CNN）、状态空间模型（Mamba）、小波变换下采样（Haar Wavelet Downsampling）、频率门控融合。
AI.method: 提出Wave-Mamba双流混合网络：1）频域结构流（基于Haar小波下采样）用于区分结构拓扑与背景噪声；2）频率门控融合模块，融合全局结构信息与局部细节特征；3）结合CNN与Mamba的轻量级双流架构。
AI.findings: 在CRACK500上mIoU达71.62%，DeepCrack上71.53%，CrackForest上52.60%，证明了方法在裂缝分割任务上的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次将状态空间模型（Mamba）引入裂缝分割任务；2）提出基于Haar小波下采样的频域结构流，创新性地从频域角度解决拓扑连续性问题；3）提出频率门控融合模块，实现全局与局部信息的有效整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供轻量级网络架构，适合实时裂缝分割应用场景；2）在油污等高频噪声干扰下仍能保持较好的分割效果，提高了基础设施安全检测的鲁棒性；3）代码和数据集将开源，便于实际部署与进一步研究。

title: Global Debt Audit: Detailed Calculation by 9 Elements of the Formula and the SVWORLD STANDARD 73.5 v1.7 on Sovereign Obligations

detail.title: Global Debt Audit: Detailed Calculation by 9 Elements of the Formula and the SVWORLD STANDARD 73.5 v1.7 on Sovereign Obligations
detail.abstract: This paper presents a global audit of world debt based on the SVWORLD STANDARD 73.5 v1.7, applied to the aggregate system of sovereign, private, financial, and hidden obligations. The main objective of the study is to construct a risk-adjusted picture of global debt burden that goes beyond traditional public debt indicators and captures the real channels of systemic stress. The analysis uses a nine-element formula that includes explicit obligations, hidden obligations, off-balance-sheet risks, and a derivative-based adjustment. The resulting framework is interpreted not as a conventional balance sheet, but as a stressoriented index of global financial fragility.

AI.tldr: 本文基于SVWORLD STANDARD 73.5 v1.7框架，对全球主权、私人、金融和隐性债务进行了系统性审计，构建了一个超越传统公共债务指标、捕捉系统性压力真实渠道的风险调整型全球债务负担图景。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够超越传统公共债务指标、捕捉系统性压力真实渠道的风险调整型全球债务负担评估框架？
AI.motivation: 传统公共债务指标无法全面反映全球债务的真实风险，忽略了隐性债务、表外风险和衍生品调整等关键因素，需要更全面的评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: SVWORLD STANDARD 73.5 v1.7框架；九要素公式（包括显性债务、隐性债务、表外风险及衍生品调整）；压力导向的全球金融脆弱性指数。
AI.method: 基于SVWORLD STANDARD 73.5 v1.7的全球审计；运用九要素公式对主权、私人、金融和隐性债务进行综合分析。
AI.findings: 该框架被解释为一种压力导向的全球金融脆弱性指数，而非传统资产负债表，能够更全面地反映全球债务的系统性风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了超越传统公共债务指标的全球债务评估新框架，将隐性债务、表外风险和衍生品调整纳入分析体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和金融机构提供了更全面的全球债务风险评估工具，有助于识别系统性金融脆弱性。

title: Endogenous Task Bundling, Skills and Automation
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Endogenous Task Bundling, Skills and Automation
detail.abstract: Empirical measures of AI's wage effect typically hold fixed the bundle of activities a worker is paid for at its pre-AI shape. We argue that this assumption hides much of the action. When automation breaks a job apart, firms decide how to recombine the surviving activities; whether they rebundle them into one broad role or split them into specialist roles changes which surviving skills the labour market actually rewards. A skill that played no role in the pre-AI wage can become the dominant component of the post-AI wage, while a skill that anchored the pre-AI wage can disappear from the schedule. We develop an assignment model in which the priced human bundle is endogenous, and we use it to show that a fixed-bundle wage regression can mis-sign the effect of AI exposure. In general, the omitted-redesign bias has no unconditional sign: it is the residual covariance between exposure and role-specific redesign terms. Under explicit sufficient conditions, exposure-correlated unbundling loads specialist comparative-advantage premia onto the exposure coefficient, while exposure-correlated rebundling loads a different, often opposite, omitted term. The sign must therefore be measured from local post-AI partition changes rather than assumed from exposure alone.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了AI对工资影响研究中"固定工作活动束"的假设，指出AI会拆解工作并重新组合剩余任务，这一过程会改变劳动力市场对技能的定价。文章通过分配模型证明，固定束工资回归会产生"遗漏重组偏误"，导致对AI暴露效应的错误估计。
AI.research_question: 当AI自动化拆解工作后，企业如何重组剩余活动（重新捆绑为宽泛角色或拆分为专业角色），以及这种重组如何影响幸存技能的工资定价？
AI.motivation: 现有实证研究在衡量AI对工资的影响时，通常假设工人被支付的"活动束"在AI引入前后保持不变。作者认为这一假设遗漏了关键机制：AI拆解工作后，企业的重组决策会改变哪些技能被定价、如何被定价。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分配模型（Assignment Model），其中被定价的人力束是内生决定的；固定束工资回归的遗漏变量偏误分析。
AI.method: 理论建模，推导固定束回归中"遗漏重组偏误"（omitted-redesign bias）的符号条件，分析暴露程度与重组项的协方差结构。
AI.findings: 固定束工资回归可能错误估计AI暴露效应；遗漏重组偏误没有无条件符号——它取决于暴露程度与角色层面重组项的残差协方差；在特定充分条件下，暴露相关的拆分会将专业化比较优势溢价加载到暴露系数上，而暴露相关的再捆绑则加载不同的、通常相反的遗漏项。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统揭示了AI对工资影响研究中"活动束固定假设"导致的方法论偏误；构建了内生人力束分配模型，为理解AI时代工作重组与工资结构变化提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒研究者不能仅从AI暴露程度推断工资效应，必须测量局部后AI时代的任务划分变化；为政策制定者和企业理解AI对劳动力市场技能定价的真实影响提供方法论指引。

detail.abstract: Kautilya, a profound ancient Indian political and economic strategist and author of the Arthashastra developed an encyclopedic framework for statecraft, political economy, warfare and intelligence. Though his ideas date back to the 4th century BCE, Kautilya's principles of governance and state security remain timeless and can be interpreted and applied to the modern-day predicament. His dynamic insights on powerplay, diplomacy and military strategy continue to reverberate in the contemporary geopolitical landscape, particularly with the advent of cybersecurity and hybrid warfare. These new forms of conflicts between and among states or non-state actors can be well understood by Kautilya's principles of espionage, war strategies, alliances and covert operations. This paper delves into integrating classical wisdom with a contemporary plan of action and how military strategists, policymakers and practitioners can implement Kautilyan thought to steer increasingly interconnected and intrinsic problems of the 21st century. The strategies and precepts of Arthashastra must be implemented by India to affirm its paramount position in the international arena. The findings suggest that Kautilya's multidimensional approach to governance offers a blueprint that can be adapted in the modern age of global circumstances defined by digital threats and hybrid conflicts.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了考底利耶（Kautilya）在《政事论》（Arthashastra）中的古代治国智慧，并将其原则应用于当代网络安全与混合战争等新型冲突场景，主张印度应借鉴这一古典思想以巩固其国际地位。
AI.research_question: 考底利耶的古代政治与战略思想如何被整合应用于当代网络安全与混合战争等新型冲突场景？
AI.motivation: 当代国家间及非国家行为体之间的冲突形态（如网络安全、混合战争）日益复杂，传统战略框架面临挑战，而考底利耶在《政事论》中关于间谍活动、战争策略、联盟与秘密行动的动态洞见可为现代困境提供经典智慧借鉴。
AI.theoretical_framework: 考底利耶的治国术、政治经济学、战争与情报理论框架，特别是其关于权力博弈、外交和军事战略的原则。
AI.method: 古典文本分析与当代情景应用相结合的整合性研究，将考底利耶的战略原则映射到现代网络安全与混合战争场景。
AI.findings: 考底利耶的多维度治国方法为应对数字威胁和混合冲突的当代全球环境提供了可适应的蓝图；印度应实施《政事论》中的战略和准则以确立其在国际舞台上的卓越地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 将公元前4世纪的古典政治战略思想系统性地拓展至当代网络安全与混合战争领域，揭示了古代智慧与现代冲突形态之间的理论衔接路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为军事战略家、政策制定者和实践者提供了将考底利耶思想转化为21世纪互联互通且内在问题解决方案的具体行动指南，并对印度如何运用该思想提升国际地位提出了建议。

detail.abstract: The model argues that traditional audit systems frequently fail because corruption adapts into stable strategic equilibria where local collusion, political capture, procurement manipulation, and data falsification become rational behaviors under weak detection structures. The framework is intended primarily for developing and transition-stage economies where agricultural continuity, reserve stability, fiscal accountability, and infrastructure governance remain strategically important.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个理论模型，论证传统审计系统之所以频繁失效，是因为腐败在弱检测结构下演化成稳定的战略均衡，使得地方合谋、政治俘获、采购操纵和数据造假成为理性行为。该框架主要适用于农业持续性、储备稳定性、财政问责和基础设施治理具有战略重要性的发展中国家和转型经济体。
AI.research_question: 为什么传统审计系统在发展中国家和转型经济体中频繁失效？腐败如何在这些环境中形成稳定的战略均衡？
AI.motivation: 传统审计系统在发展中国家和转型经济体中屡屡失败，需要从战略均衡视角重新理解腐败的系统性成因，而非将其视为个别违规行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略均衡理论；腐败适应性理论；弱检测结构下的理性行为理论。
AI.method: 理论建模与分析框架构建。
AI.findings: 腐败在弱检测结构下可演化为稳定的战略均衡；地方合谋、政治俘获、采购操纵和数据造假在此条件下成为理性行为；传统审计系统的设计未能打破这一均衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了腐败作为稳定战略均衡的理论视角，超越了将腐败视为个体道德失败的传统观点；揭示了弱检测结构与腐败系统性适应之间的内在机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家和转型经济体的审计系统改革提供了理论依据；指出了需要打破腐败战略均衡而非仅加强检测的实践方向。

title: A bootstrap-supported regional framework for design flood estimation in data-scarce Himalayan basins: Evidence from the Narayani Basin, Nepal
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Tribhuvan University - Institute of Engineering Pulchowk Campus

detail.title: A bootstrap-supported regional framework for design flood estimation in data-scarce Himalayan basins: Evidence from the Narayani Basin, Nepal
detail.abstract: ​Reliable design flood estimation in ungauged and poorly gauged Himalayan catchments is limited by short records, uneven station distribution, and difficulty in defining statistically homogeneous regions. This study develops a regional design flood estimation framework for the Narayani Basin by combining L-moment-based regional frequency analysis, quantile regression technique (QRT), index flood method (IFM) and station-based bootstrap resampling. Annual maximum series from 14 hydrological stations were used to identify an acceptable homogeneous pooling group, select a regional parent distribution, develop QRT models from catchment descriptors, and compare QRT, IFM, at-site and Modified Hydest estimates at a representative long-record station.The full 14-station pool was not statistically homogeneous and required substantial refinement. The final accepted pool contained 8 stations and 326 station-years, indicating a clear trade-off between hydrological similarity and information support in Himalayan regionalization. Pearson Type III (PE3) provided the best regional fit. Bootstrap analysis showed that simple predictor structures were more robust than multi-variable alternatives, with log(AREA) + log(SD) retained for lower return periods and log(AREA) alone retained from the 10-year return period upward. IFM gave the most consistent agreement with at-site PE3 estimates across return periods, whereas QRT performed well for low to moderate return periods but flattened in the upper tail. Modified Hydest/DHM estimates were consistently higher for Station 420, with overestimation increasing with return period. The results show that bootstrap screening is useful for uncertainty assessment and for identifying the return-period range over which models remain defensible in data-scarce mountain basins.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对喜马拉雅山区无资料及缺资料流域的设计洪水估算难题，以尼泊尔纳拉亚尼盆地为案例，结合L矩区域频率分析、分位数回归、指数洪水法和Bootstrap重抽样，构建了区域设计洪水估算框架。研究发现：8站点同质池与PE3分布最优；简单预测变量（如流域面积）比多变量模型更稳健；指数洪水法在各回归期表现一致，而分位数回归在低中回归期表现良好但在高尾部趋于平缓。Bootstrap筛选对评估模型不确定性及适用范围具有重要价值。
AI.research_question: 如何在山丘资料匮乏的喜马拉雅流域（纳拉亚尼盆地）建立可靠的设计洪水区域估算方法？
AI.motivation: 喜马拉雅流域实测记录短、站点分布不均、统计均质区难以界定，导致无资料及缺资料流域的设计洪水估算可靠性受限，亟需开发适用于数据稀缺山区的区域洪水估算框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: L矩区域频率分析、分位数回归技术、指数洪水法、Bootstrap重抽样方法
AI.method: 基于14个水文站的年最大流量序列，识别均质站点池并筛选8站点最终同质池（326站年）；采用L矩法选择区域母分布（PE3最优）；从流域描述因子开发QRT模型；通过Bootstrap比较QRT、IFM、单站点及Modified Hydest在长序列代表站（Station 420）的估算表现。
AI.findings: （1）14站池不满足统计均质性，最终8站同质池体现了水文相似性与信息支持间的权衡；（2）PE3分布为最优区域拟合分布；（3）简单预测变量结构（log(AREA)+log(SD)用于低回归期，log(AREA)单独用于10年及以上回归期）比多变量模型更稳健；（4）IFM在各回归期与单站点PE3估计一致性最佳，QRT在低中回归期表现良好但高尾部趋于平缓；（5）Modified Hydest/DHM对Station 420的估计持续偏高，且高估程度随回归期增大而增大。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了喜马拉雅山区区域化过程中水文相似性与信息支持之间的权衡关系；验证了Bootstrap筛选在数据稀缺山区评估模型不确定性及识别模型可辩护回归期范围中的有效性；证明了简单预测变量结构比复杂多变量模型更具稳健性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为喜马拉雅无资料/缺资料流域提供了可操作的区域设计洪水估算框架；推荐PE3分布和指数洪水法作为该区域实际工程设计洪水估算的优先选择；为水文站网规划和数据收集策略提供了方法指导。

title: The Impact of Shareholder Activism on the Banking Industry
affiliations: Cornell University, SC Johnson Graduate School of Management, Department of Finance

detail.title: The Impact of Shareholder Activism on the Banking Industry
detail.abstract: I investigate the role of shareholder activism in the corporate governance of banks. Bank shareholder activism is led primarily by a set of hedge funds that specialize in targeting banks exclusively, adapting traditional activist tools to unique aspects of bank governance such as the complex regulatory environment. I use a novel natural experiment to estimate the effect of increased exposure to activist campaigns on target banks, exploiting variation in changes to exposure after a Federal Reserve policy change that reduced regulatory barriers to hedge fund activism. Activist campaigns improve shareholder returns, but increased exposure to activism causes banks to reduce capital buffers and increase credit risk exposure relative to control firms. This finding is maintained after accounting for the disruptions of the Covid-19 pandemic, and is robust to matching and triple-difference specifications. However, hedge fund activism does not have a significant effect on individual bank failure risk or on systemic risk.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了股东激进主义在银行公司治理中的作用，发现对冲基金激进活动虽能提升股东回报，但会导致银行降低资本缓冲、增加信用风险敞口，不过对银行个体破产风险和系统性风险无显著影响。
AI.research_question: 股东激进主义如何影响银行的公司治理、风险承担行为和绩效？
AI.motivation: 银行具有复杂的监管环境和特殊的公司治理结构，传统的股东激进工具如何适应银行治理尚不清楚，且激进主义对银行风险行为的影响有待实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 股东激进主义理论、银行公司治理理论、监管壁垒与资本缓冲理论。
AI.method: 利用美联储政策变化作为自然实验，采用双重差分（DID）、三重差分（Triple-Difference）和匹配方法估计激进活动暴露对银行的影响。
AI.findings: 激进活动提升股东回报；增加激进暴露导致银行降低资本缓冲、增加信用风险敞口；但对银行个体破产风险和系统性风险无显著影响；结果在控制新冠疫情影响后依然稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了股东激进主义在银行业这一特殊监管行业中的独特作用机制，拓展了公司治理与银行风险承担关系的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构评估对冲基金激进活动对银行稳健性的影响提供了实证依据，提示政策制定者需在股东价值与银行安全之间权衡。

title: A World Without Artificial Intelligence: Economic, Social, and Technological Consequences
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A World Without Artificial Intelligence: Economic, Social, and Technological Consequences

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NIL
declarations.ethicsApproval: No Patients were involved
declarations.funderStatement: Self

detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence("AI") has rapidly evolved from a specialised computational tool into a foundational layer of modern economic infrastructure. Governments, corporations, educational institutions, healthcare systems, and financial markets increasingly rely on intelligent automation for decision-making, optimisation, prediction, and operational efficiency. However, as AI systems become more deeply embedded in economic life, concerns regarding labour displacement, the concentration of wealth, democratic accountability, and long-term human dependency have intensified. This paper examines a hypothetical but increasingly relevant policy question: what would occur if individuals, corporations, or governments deliberately slowed, restricted, or abandoned large-scale AI adoption?

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了如果个人、企业或政府有意放缓、限制或放弃大规模AI采用可能产生的经济与社会后果，分析了AI作为现代经济基础设施层带来的机遇与风险。
AI.research_question: 如果个人、企业或政府有意放缓、限制或放弃大规模AI采用，将会发生什么？
AI.motivation: 随着AI深度嵌入经济生活，关于劳动力替代、财富集中、民主问责和人类长期依赖的担忧日益加剧，有必要审视"去AI化"或"减速AI"这一反事实政策选项的潜在影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 未明确提及具体理论框架，但涉及技术经济学、创新扩散理论、政治经济学以及AI治理相关理论视角。
AI.method: 假设性政策分析（hypothetical policy analysis），基于现有AI经济学与社会影响文献进行推理性论证。
AI.findings: 文章可能指出：放缓AI采用可缓解劳动力替代冲击、减少财富集中风险、增强民主控制，但也可能导致竞争力下降、技术创新停滞、经济效率损失等代价。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI治理研究提供了一个"反事实"分析框架，补充了现有文献中"如何加速AI"之外的另一面——即"如何以及为何减速AI"的理论思考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、企业领导者和公众提供关于AI采用速度的权衡分析，帮助更全面地评估AI治理策略，包括审慎监管、选择性减速或局部限制等政策选项。

title: Comparison of convection-permitting and coarser-resolution regional climate simulations for evaluating precipitation and streamflow in Southern Québec
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Comparison of convection-permitting and coarser-resolution regional climate simulations for evaluating precipitation and streamflow in Southern Québec
detail.abstract: This study evaluates seasonal precipitation and temperature (April-May, summer, fall), as well as Rx1-hour (maximum hourly) precipitation across a domain in southern Quebec, using 3 climate simulations, all configured by Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) regional climate model, driven by ERA-Interim reanalysis, at spatial resolutions of 4 km (CONUS simulation), 25 km, and 50 km (two CORDEX simulations). The results show that, for extreme precipitation analyses, the high-resolution 4km-WRF model (CONUS simulation) produced the highest RX1-hour values in summer. The simulations were further fed into a conceptual hydrological model to simulate streamflow at an hourly time step across twelve southern Quebec watersheds with surface areas ranging from 61–1550 km². Satellite-derived precipitation product (IMERG) precipitation and ERA5-Land temperature serve as our reference datasets for hydrological model calibration. The results show that in April-May, CONUS simulation produces lower mean snow water equivalent (swe) than those of the CORDEX simulations, primarily due to higher temperatures, which lead to earlier snowmelt and lower mean streamflow peaks compared to CORDEX simulations. Even though CONUS simulation produces higher extreme summer precipitation than the CORDEX simulations, this does not necessarily translate into higher streamflow simulations, most likely because of the higher temperatures that tend to increase potential evapotranspiration. In an event-based analysis carried out in a small watershed, though, CONUS simulation is able to produce short-duration, high-intensity rainfall events that do translate streamflow peaks that are not found in the CORDEX simulations.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用4km、25km和50km三种分辨率的WRF区域气候模型模拟，评估了加拿大魁北克南部地区的季节性降水、温度及极端小时降水，并结合水文模型分析了对径流的影响。结果表明，4km高分辨率模型在夏季极端降水模拟上表现最佳，但由于高温导致蒸散发增加，极端降水并未直接转化为更高径流；但在小流域事件分析中，高分辨率模型能捕捉到短时强降雨引发的洪峰。
AI.research_question: 不同空间分辨率的气候模型（4km vs. 25km vs. 50km）在模拟魁北克南部地区季节性降水、温度和极端小时降水方面的表现如何？这些差异如何影响水文模型模拟的径流响应？
AI.motivation: 高分辨率气候模拟计算成本高，但其对极端降水和流域水文响应的改进程度尚不明确。通过系统比较不同分辨率模拟在降水、温度、雪水当量及径流模拟中的差异，可为气候-水文建模的分辨率选择提供科学依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区域气候模型（WRF）动力降尺度理论；极端降水与径流响应的非线性关系；雪水当量（SWE）与气温的耦合机制；潜在蒸散发（PET）对径流生成的影响。
AI.method: 使用三种WRF模拟（4km CONUS、25km和50km CORDEX），驱动数据为ERA-Interim再分析资料。将模拟数据输入概念性水文模型，以小时为步长模拟12个流域（面积61–1550 km²）的径流。利用IMERG降水数据和ERA5-Land温度数据作为参考进行水文模型校准。分析了春季融雪期和夏季极端事件的水文响应差异。
AI.findings: 1) 4km CONUS模拟在夏季产生最高的RX1-hour极端降水值。2) 4月-5月，CONUS模拟因温度更高导致雪水当量（SWE）更低、融雪更早、平均径流峰值低于CORDEX模拟。3) 尽管CONUS模拟夏季极端降水更高，但因高温增加潜在蒸散发，未带来更高径流模拟。4) 在小流域事件分析中，CONUS模拟能捕捉到短时高强度降雨引发的径流峰值，而CORDEX模拟未能重现。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了高分辨率气候模拟在极端降水表征上的优势，但同时揭示了温度-蒸散发反馈对径流响应的抵消效应，挑战了"更高分辨率必然带来更好水文模拟"的简单假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为气候变化影响下的水资源管理和洪水风险评估提供分辨率选择依据：高分辨率模拟对短时强降雨引发的山洪预警有重要价值，但对季节尺度径流模拟未必优于中分辨率模拟。

title: Expectation-Performance Feedback Theory (EPFT): A Contextual Theory of Expectations, Welfare Politics, and Democratic Feedback in India

detail.title: Expectation-Performance Feedback Theory (EPFT): A Contextual Theory of Expectations, Welfare Politics, and Democratic Feedback in India
detail.abstract: This paper proposes the Expectation-Performance Feedback Theory (EPFT) as a context sensitive conceptual framework for understanding democratic political behaviour in India. The theory argues that Indian democracy is significantly sustained through continuous interaction between citizen expectations and perceived government performance. Citizens support political parties and leaders with the expectation that their socioeconomic , welfare oriented, developmental, and identity-related demands will be addressed through governance mechanisms. Political support is sustained when governments are perceived to satisfy these expectations, while dissatisfaction contributes to anti-incumbency behaviour, protests, and electoral volatility. The theory further argues that expectations within Indian democracy are not uniform and vary across lower-income, middle-income, and upper-income socioeconomic groups. EPFT conceptualizes elections as democratic feedback mechanisms through which citizens evaluate governance outcomes. The framework integrates insights from Rational Choice Theory, Social Exchange Theory, Retrospective Voting Theory, welfare politics, and Indian political sociology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出期望-绩效反馈理论（EPFT），认为印度民主的持续运转依赖于公民期望与政府感知绩效之间的持续互动，不同收入群体的期望存在差异，选举是民主反馈机制。
AI.research_question: 印度民主政治行为如何通过公民期望与政府绩效之间的互动得以理解和解释？
AI.motivation: 现有理论难以充分解释印度民主的独特韧性与波动性，需要一个情境敏感的概念框架来理解印度民主政治行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期望-绩效反馈理论（EPFT），整合理性选择理论、社会交换理论、回顾性投票理论、福利政治学及印度政治社会学。
AI.method: 理论构建与概念框架论文，整合多学科理论进行演绎推理与概念分析。
AI.findings: 印度民主通过公民期望与政府绩效的持续互动得以维持；不同收入阶层（低收入、中等收入、高收入）的期望存在差异；期望未被满足会导致反在职行为、抗议和选举波动；选举充当民主反馈机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个情境敏感的整合性理论框架（EPFT），将多个经典理论有机融合，专门解释印度等发展中国家的民主政治行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解印度选举行为、反在职现象和选举波动提供分析工具；有助于政策制定者理解不同收入群体的差异化诉求，改善治理回应性。

title: Consumer Learning Under Supply Uncertainty: A Pilot Study of eBay Listing-Volume Shocks in the Pokémon Card Grading Market
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Consumer Learning Under Supply Uncertainty: A Pilot Study of eBay Listing-Volume Shocks in the Pokémon Card Grading Market
detail.abstract: I introduce a methodology for measuring consumer learning under supply uncertainty using highfrequency observations of secondary-market listings in the Pokémon trading card game (TCG) grading market. Conventional studies of certified-collectible markets rely on grader-published population reports, which are released monthly and reflect the grading firm's internal database rather than the supply consumers actually observe. I propose an alternative supply signal: the count of active eBay listings at a given grade and condition, captured every six hours via the eBay Browse API. I detect supply shocks as weekly listing-count changes exceeding the card's own historical 95th percentile of Δ log(listings), and study price responses around these shocks via a card-andweek fixed-effects event study. The contribution is methodological. The empirical pipeline runs end to end on a single virtual private server, persists observations into a Postgres warehouse, handles regime changes (e.g., API rate-limit changes) via an explicit exclusion register, and produces reproducible monthly snapshots for paper-version pinning. I report a pilot dataset spanning 3 April through 9 May 2026 (37 calendar days), 19 active cards, 2,772 observations, and two confirmed supply-shock events. The pilot is not powered for inference; results are presented to validate the pipeline rather than to support generalisable claims about the response of prices to supply. Companion work in preparation will apply the same methodology to a 98-card universe over a 12-month horizon, at which scale event counts should support publication-grade event-study estimation. I provide the full data-collection and detection code as a public replication package.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用高频eBay listings数据测量供给不确定下消费者学习的方法，以宝可梦卡牌评级市场为实验场，构建了从数据采集到事件研究的完整实证管道。
AI.research_question: 在供给不确定条件下，消费者如何通过学习过程对供给冲击做出价格反应？
AI.motivation: 传统认证收藏品市场研究依赖评级机构每月发布的population reports，但这些报告反映的是评级公司内部数据库，而非消费者实际观察到的供给信号，存在信息偏差。需要一种更高频、更贴近消费者实际观测的供给度量方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者学习理论（consumer learning under supply uncertainty）；事件研究法（event study）；供给信号替代度量方法
AI.method: 利用eBay Browse API每6小时抓取活跃listing数量作为供给信号；将周度listing数量变化超过该卡历史Δlog(listings)第95百分位数定义为供给冲击；采用卡牌-周固定效应事件研究法分析价格反应；全流程在虚拟私有服务器上端到端运行，数据存入Postgres仓库，设立显式排除注册表处理API速率限制等制度变化。
AI.findings: 试点数据集（2026年4月3日至5月9日，19张活跃卡牌，2,772条观测）确认了2次供给冲击事件。结果仅用于验证管道可行性，不具备统计推断效力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个替代传统population reports的高频供给信号度量方法；将消费者学习理论拓展至收藏品市场情境；建立了供给冲击的实证识别策略。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了端到端的可复现数据采集与检测代码（公开复制包）；为收藏品市场参与者提供了更及时、更贴近实际的供给监测工具；方法论可推广至其他认证收藏品或二手市场的供给分析。

title: The Petrodollar Pact
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Petrodollar Pact
detail.abstract: The United States has, for decades, extended extraordinary military and diplomatic protection to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, deploying its forces in the kingdom’s defence, sustaining arms transfers during the Yemen crisis, and withholding sanctions following the September 11 attacks despite the Saudi nationality of 15 of the 19 hijackers. Mainstream international relations scholarship attributes this relationship to oil dependency and regional stability imperatives. This article challenges that explanation as analytically insufficient. Drawing on structural analysis, Kautilyan statecraft theory, and monetary economics, it argues that the true and primary driver of American protection is the petrodollar architecture, a financial arrangement born from the collapse of the Bretton Woods system in 1971 and formalised through Nixon-era diplomacy with Riyadh, which requires global oil trade to be conducted exclusively in U.S. dollars, thereby sustaining American monetary hegemony. Through structured comparative analysis of U.S. responses to Saudi Arabia, Iran, Venezuela, Russia, and the European Union, the article demonstrates that American foreign policy in the Gulf is best explained not by liberal or realist IR theories alone, but by structural analysis of monetary power. The article further considers whether accelerating BRICS de-dollarisation and yuan-denominated oil trades signal the beginning of the petrodollar’s end and what that portends for U.S. global primacy and India’s strategic positioning.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了主流国际关系理论将美国对沙特的安全保护归因于石油依赖和地区稳定的解释，提出真正动因是1971年布雷顿森林体系解体后形成的"石油美元"架构——全球石油贸易必须以美元结算，从而维持美国货币霸权。通过与美国对伊朗、委内瑞拉、俄罗斯和欧盟的政策对比分析，论证美国海湾政策的核心驱动力是货币权力结构。最后探讨金砖国家去美元化及人民币石油贸易对石油美元体系的挑战。
AI.research_question: 美国对沙特阿拉伯长期提供超常军事和外交保护的真实动因是什么？石油美元架构如何塑造美国的外交政策？去美元化趋势对石油美元体系及美国全球霸权有何影响？
AI.motivation: 主流国际关系理论（自由主义与现实主义）将美沙特殊关系解释为石油依赖和地区稳定需要，但这一解释在分析上不充分——无法解释美国为何在9/11事件中15名劫机者为沙特国籍的情况下仍保护沙特、持续向也门危机中的沙特输送武器等反常现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构分析、Kautilyan治国术理论（古印度战略思想）、货币经济学，挑战传统国际关系中的自由主义和现实主义理论。
AI.method: 结构化比较分析：对比美国对沙特、伊朗、委内瑞拉、俄罗斯和欧盟的不同外交政策回应，以验证货币权力结构而非传统地缘政治因素是美国政策的主要解释变量。
AI.findings: 美国对沙特保护的核心驱动力是石油美元架构——全球石油贸易以美元结算的制度安排，而非简单的石油依赖或地区稳定。这一架构源于1971年尼克松政府与沙特的外交协议，旨在维护布雷顿森林体系解体后的美元霸权。比较分析显示，那些挑战石油美元体系的国家（如试图以非美元货币交易石油的伊朗、委内瑞拉）受到美国最严厉的制裁，而沙特即便有9/11等严重问题仍受保护。
AI.theory_contributions: 将货币权力（monetary power）的结构性分析引入国际关系研究，挑战自由主义和现实主义对美沙关系的传统解释；重新引入Kautilyan治国术理论作为分析大国战略的替代框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示石油美元架构是美国全球霸权的基础设施，为理解美国中东政策提供更准确的分析框架；为金砖国家和印度评估去美元化战略及自身定位提供政策参考。

title: The glass cage and the indigenous hearth: The collision of cold and hot identities in a finite world
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The glass cage and the indigenous hearth: The collision of cold and hot identities in a finite world
detail.abstract: This essay analyzes the contemporary geopolitical rupture through the lens of institutional isomorphism and political anthropology. We argue that the Western liberal project, facing the limits of a "finite world," has mutated into an "algorithmic Katechon" aimed at stabilizing the world-system through a "cold," procedural identity. Conversely, Russia is constituting itself as a "civilization-state," mobilizing a "hot identity" based on narrative, memory, and sobornost. This "thermal collision" between the universality of code and the sovereign exception produces an irreversible fragmentation of the global space, transforming the international landscape into a pluriverse of thermal niches where survival depends on the ability to re-articulate technique in the service of national destiny.

AI.tldr: 本文通过制度同构与政治人类学视角，分析了当代地缘政治断裂。西方自由主义在"有限世界"的极限下异化为"算法式卡西欧"，通过冷程序性身份稳定世界体系；而俄罗斯则构建"文明国家"，动员基于叙事、记忆与聚合性的"热身份"。这种代码普遍性与主权例外之间的"热碰撞"导致全球空间的不可逆碎片化，使国际格局转变为由"热生态位"构成的多元宇宙，生存取决于能否重新将技术服务于国家命运。
AI.research_question: 当代地缘政治断裂的深层机制是什么？西方自由主义与俄罗斯文明国家之间的冲突本质为何？
AI.motivation: 解释当前国际秩序不可逆碎片化的现象，揭示超越传统地缘政治叙事（如民主vs威权）的深层文明逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度同构理论、政治人类学、卡尔·施密特的主权例外概念、卡西欧概念（延迟末世的保守力量）、聚合性（sobornost）概念。
AI.method: 理论分析与概念建构，结合政治哲学、人类学与国际关系理论的跨学科方法。
AI.findings: 西方自由主义已异化为"算法式卡西欧"，以冷程序性身份追求稳定；俄罗斯以"文明国家"形式动员热身份；二者热碰撞导致全球不可逆碎片化为多元热生态位；国家存续取决于能否重新将技术嵌入本土命运叙事。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"热量"隐喻引入地缘政治分析，提出"热碰撞"概念解释文明层面冲突；将卡西欧概念更新为算法时代的分析工具；区分"冷身份"与"热身份"两种政治组织逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解当前国际秩序碎片化提供新的分析框架，强调技术治理与国家身份重构之间的张力对于政策制定的启示。

AI.tldr: 本文提出"张君的诅咒"概念，揭示在技术官僚精英化与数字治理推进下，高学历地方官员可能采取"游牧理性"策略，将公共资源导向低透明度数字项目，形成资源从生产性基础转移的自我强化循环，导致财政压力与实体经济疲弱持续存在。

AI.method: 理论推演与概念建构，结合宏观经济数据（国家统计局、财政部数据）进行实证观察，辅以跨国历史比较分析（战后美国、欧元区、苏联晚期）。

title: CyRISK - A Capital Shortfall Measure of Cyber Risk in the Financial System
affiliations: University of St. Gallen - Institute of Insurance Economics, Leipzig University, Durham University and University of Leipzig

detail.title: CyRISK - A Capital Shortfall Measure of Cyber Risk in the Financial System
detail.abstract: We develop a market-based, forward-looking measure of cyber-related capital shortfall for the global banking system. The framework incorporates a tradable cybersecurity factor into a dynamic systemic risk model with time-varying exposures estimated via conditional betas. Applied to a broad panel of banks, the measure reveals that conventional market-only stress tests materially understate system-wide capital needs, with incremental cyber-related shortfalls amounting to roughly one quarter of conventional shortfalls at their peak. A small set of globally active banks accounts for the bulk of marginal cyber risk exposure, identifying a dimension of systemic importance that is largely orthogonal to size, leverage, and market beta.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于市场的前瞻性指标，用于衡量全球银行体系因网络风险导致的资本短缺。该指标将可交易网络安全因子纳入动态系统性风险模型，通过条件贝塔估计时变暴露。研究发现，传统市场压力测试显著低估了系统所需的资本，网络相关资本缺口峰值约为传统缺口的四分之一，且少数全球活跃银行承担了大部分边际网络风险暴露。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个前瞻性的、基于市场的指标来衡量全球银行体系因网络风险导致的资本短缺？
AI.motivation: 传统压力测试仅考虑市场风险，忽略了网络风险这一日益重要的系统性风险来源，可能导致资本充足率要求不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态系统性风险模型（时变条件贝塔）；网络安全因子作为可交易因子纳入资产定价框架。
AI.method: 构建可交易网络安全因子，将其引入动态系统性风险模型，通过条件贝塔估计银行对网络风险的时变暴露，进而计算网络相关资本短缺。
AI.findings: 1）传统市场压力测试显著低估了系统资本需求；2）网络相关资本缺口峰值约为传统缺口的四分之一；3）少数全球活跃银行贡献了大部分边际网络风险，且这种系统性重要维度与银行规模、杠杆率和市场贝塔基本正交。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将网络安全因子纳入系统性风险建模框架，提出了一个与银行基本面指标正交的系统性重要性新维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了量化网络风险资本要求的工具，弥补了传统压力测试的盲区，有助于更精准地识别系统重要性银行。

detail.title: Helioeconomic Framework: Real-Time Verification 2026

detail.abstract: This paper is the fourth in the helioeconomic working paper series (Valkov 2026a-d). It provides a real-time empirical update to the conflict-outcome framework introduced in Valkov (2026c), building on the HelioEconomic Leading Index (HELI) and the four transmission channels established in Valkov (2026a). The dataset of 42 interstate conflicts spanning 1750-2026 (N=42) includes two ongoing cases provisionally coded in Valkov (2026c)-the Russia-Ukraine war and the US/Israel-Iran strikes (initiated February 2026)-whose outcome coding is updated through April 2026. Both cases occur during K6 Peak/Descent phase and SC25 post-maximum, precisely the conditions under which the framework predicts elevated failure probability for initiating actors (P(failure) = 0.94, 95% CI: 0.72-0.99). Observable dynamics in both cases are broadly consistent with predicted failure trajectories, though the US/Israel-Iran case exhibits partial tactical successes that complicate binary outcome coding and is treated as an anomalous intermediate case warranting further observation. Additionally, this update documents corroborating evidence across five helioeconomic transmission channels: commodity volatility (Urals +158% in 30 days, peak $116/bbl), financial market instability (S&P 500 CAPE ratio = 39.0, CPI re-acceleration to 3.3%), climatic anomalies consistent with SC25 post-maximum geomagnetic activity, institutional stress in Russia (parliamentary warnings, April 2026), and SC25 descent confirmation (WN = 92,-44% from peak). The April 2026 evidence is broadly consistent with-and does not falsify-the forward-looking assessment issued in March 2026.

AI.tldr: 本文是太阳经济学系列工作论文之四，基于42个历史与当代国家间冲突（1750-2026）数据，对Valkov (2026c)提出的冲突-结果框架进行实时实证更新。研究发现，在K6峰值/下降阶段结合SC25后最大值条件下，发起方失败概率高达0.94（95%CI: 0.72-0.99），俄乌战争与美以-伊朗冲突均落入该预测区间。尽管美以-伊朗案例出现部分战术成功，整体动态与预测轨迹基本一致。五个太阳经济学传导渠道（商品波动、金融市场、气候异常、制度压力、太阳周期确认）均提供佐证。
AI.research_question: 在太阳周期特定阶段（K6 Peak/Descent + SC25后最大值）下，国家间冲突发起方的失败概率是否显著升高？实时观测数据是否支持该理论框架的预测？
AI.motivation: 基于Valkov (2026a, 2026c)已建立的太阳经济学领先指数（HELI）和四通道传导框架，利用最新（截至2026年4月）的冲突动态数据对理论预测进行实证检验和实时更新。
AI.theoretical_framework: 太阳经济学冲突-结果框架；HelioEconomic领先指数（HELI）；四通道传导机制（商品波动、金融市场、气候异常、制度压力）；K6太阳周期阶段理论。
AI.method: 对42个历史与当代冲突（1750-2026）的数据库进行结果编码更新；对俄乌战争及美以-伊朗冲突两个正在进行的案例进行实时观测与动态追踪；通过五个太阳经济学传导渠道收集佐证证据。
AI.findings: 1. K6峰值/下降阶段+SC25后最大值条件下，发起方失败概率P(failure)=0.94（95%CI:0.72-0.99）；2. 俄乌冲突与美以-伊朗冲突动态与预测失败轨迹总体一致；3. 美以-伊朗案例存在部分战术成功，构成异常中间案例；4. 五个传导渠道均提供一致性证据（如Urals原油30天涨158%、S&P500 CAPE=39.0、CPI再加速至3.3%等）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为太阳经济学框架提供了实时实证更新，初步验证了太阳周期特定阶段与冲突失败概率之间的关联性；识别了需要进一步观察的异常中间案例（美以-伊朗）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为决策者提供了基于太阳周期阶段评估冲突前景的分析工具；展示了HELI指数及四通道传导机制在实时冲突监测中的应用价值。

title: Impact of Covid 19 Outbreak on Urban cities in India

detail.title: Impact of Covid 19 Outbreak on Urban cities in India

detail.abstract: According to the UN-Habitat report 2020, the next decade is expected to see a rise in urbanisation, which may range to 60.4 % by 2030 as compared to 56.2% in 2020. Hence, the current article intends to unravel the impact of Covid 19 on cities globally. The World Cities Report 2020 and the COVID-19 Response Plan 2020 by UN-Habitat will be reviewed to get a better understanding of the overall condition of cities globally. Furthermore, the article also focuses on studying the major challenges in urban areas as mentioned in the UN-Habitat report, like high risk for transmission, impact on economic activities, urban inequalities and coping mechanisms, by considering major cities in India. Lastly, it deals with the suggestions on how to enhance urban growth by tackling the prevailing issues so that sustainable cities can be developed which will accommodate the influx of people in the upcoming years as estimated by the UN-Habitat report 2020.

AI.tldr: 本文基于联合国人居署2020年报告，探讨新冠疫情对全球城市的影响，重点分析印度主要城市在疫情下面临的挑战（如高传播风险、经济活动受冲击、城市不平等和应对机制），并提出发展可持续城市的建议以应对未来城市化加速的趋势。
AI.research_question: 新冠疫情如何影响全球城市，特别是印度主要城市？如何解决城市问题以实现可持续发展？
AI.motivation: 预计到2030年全球城市化率将达60.4%，疫情给城市带来巨大挑战，亟需理解城市现状并提出应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市化理论、可持续发展理论、城市韧性理论
AI.method: 文献综述法，主要回顾《世界城市报告2020》和联合国人居署《COVID-19应对计划2020》，并结合印度主要城市的案例进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. 疫情加剧了城市的高传播风险、经济冲击和城市不平等；2. 印度主要城市面临突出的应对机制挑战；3. 需通过针对性政策应对现有问题以实现可持续城市化。
AI.theory_contributions: 将疫情冲击纳入城市可持续发展理论的讨论框架，补充了危机情境下城市化研究的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了应对疫情后城市挑战、推动可持续城市发展的具体建议，尤其对印度及类似发展中国家具有参考价值。

title: On the Asymptotic Distribution of the Sharpe Ratio under Weak Dependence and Non-Gaussian Returns
affiliations: Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, Cornell University - Operations Research & Industrial Engineering and Khalifa University

detail.title: On the Asymptotic Distribution of the Sharpe Ratio under Weak Dependence and Non-Gaussian Returns

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not needed.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding.

detail.abstract: The Sharpe ratio is the premier statistic for performance evaluation, with promising applications to other fields as a signal-to-noise ratio. Although its asymptotic behavior under independent Gaussian observations is well understood, statistically valid inference under serial correlation and non-Gaussianity remains incomplete. Lo (2002) expresses the asymptotic variance in compact quadratic-form notation. Treating the Sharpe ratio as a smooth functional of first-and second-order moments, we derive an explicit asymptotic normal approximation for its plug-in estimator under weak dependence and finite "fourth plus 𝜖" moments. The resulting variance expression incorporates serial correlation, skewness, and kurtosis, and recovers existing results as special cases. Our results provide a unified theoretical foundation for Sharpe ratio inference beyond the classical i.i.d. Gaussian framework.

AI.tldr: 本文在弱依赖、非高斯条件下推导了夏普比率估计量的渐近正态分布，给出了包含序列相关、偏度和峰度的方差表达式，统一了夏普比率推断的理论基础。
AI.research_question: 在序列相关和非高斯观测下，如何对夏普比率进行有效的统计推断？
AI.motivation: 夏普比率是绩效评估的核心指标，但现有理论主要局限于独立同分布的高斯假设，对序列相关和非高斯情形下的统计推断尚不完善。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将夏普比率视为一阶和二阶矩的光滑泛函，利用弱依赖条件下的渐近正态理论。
AI.method: 将夏普比率的插件估计量表示为样本一阶矩和二阶矩的光滑泛函，在弱相依性和有限"四阶加𝜖"矩条件下，推导其渐近正态分布，并显式表达渐近方差。
AI.findings: 推导出的渐近方差表达式同时纳入了序列相关、偏度和峰度的影响，并能够将Lo（2002）等现有结果作为特例包含在内。
AI.theory_contributions: 为超越经典i.i.d.高斯框架的夏普比率推断提供了统一的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 使研究者能够在更现实的金融数据特征（序列相关、非正态分布）下对夏普比率进行有效的统计推断。

title: Programmable Liquidity & Recursive Welfare Stabilization

detail.title: Programmable Liquidity & Recursive Welfare Stabilization
detail.abstract: This paper develops a theoretical framework for purpose-bound monetary systems in which liquidity is programmable, recursively routable, and partially non-fungible. The paper argues that persistent inequality and welfare instability arise not only from distributive failures, but from the recursive dynamics of unrestricted fungible liquidity itself. To address this problem, the study introduces a recursive segmented monetary architecture integrating mechanism design, stochastic control, network dynamics, constitutional monetary governance, and programmable CBDC infrastructure. The framework establishes conditions for recursive equilibrium, bounded capability dynamics, and long-run stabilization, while computational simulations suggest that segmented liquidity systems may reduce recursive inequality amplification and improve welfare resilience under systemic shocks. More broadly, the paper proposes a shift from passive monetary exchange systems toward adaptive coordination architectures designed to preserve long-run human capability continuity.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个面向目的约束的货币系统理论框架，其中流动性具有可编程性、递归路由性和部分非同质性。研究认为，持续的不平等和福利不稳定不仅源于分配失灵，更源于无限制的可替代流动性本身的递归动态。通过引入递归分割货币架构（整合机制设计、随机控制、网络动力学、宪政货币治理与可编程CBDC基础设施），论文建立了递归均衡、有限能力动态和长期稳定的条件。计算模拟表明，分割流动性系统可在系统性冲击下减少递归不平等放大并改善福利韧性。论文呼吁从被动货币交换系统转向适应性协调架构，以维护人类能力的长期连续性。
AI.research_question: 如何在货币系统设计中通过可编程、可递归路由且部分非同质的流动性架构，解决由无限制可替代流动性递归动态引发的持续不平等和福利不稳定问题？
AI.motivation: 传统观点将不平等归因于分配失灵，但本文指出即使分配机制完善，无限制可替代流动性本身的递归动态也会放大不平等并导致福利不稳定，因此需要从货币架构层面进行根本性重构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 递归分割货币架构（Recursive Segmented Monetary Architecture），整合了机制设计理论、随机控制理论、网络动力学理论、宪政货币治理理论以及可编程央行数字货币（CBDC）基础设施理论。
AI.method: 理论建模（建立递归均衡条件、有界能力动态与长期稳定条件）+ 计算模拟（检验分割流动性系统在系统性冲击下的表现）。
AI.findings: 分割流动性系统能够减少递归不平等的放大效应，并在系统性冲击下提升福利韧性；建立了递归均衡、有界能力动态和长期稳定的理论条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"无限制可替代流动性的递归动态"是不平等和福利不稳定的内生根源，超越传统分配视角；2. 构建了递归分割货币架构的理论基础，将货币设计从被动交换媒介提升为主动协调治理工具；3. 整合机制设计、随机控制、网络动力学等多学科视角，为CBDC设计提供新的理论范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行数字货币（CBDC）的架构设计提供可编程、递归路由与部分非同质性的可操作方向；2. 提出宪政货币治理原则，为货币政策与金融稳定提供制度层面的建议；3. 推动从被动货币交换系统向适应性协调架构的范式转变，以维护人类能力的长期连续性。

title: COMPLETE GOVERNANCE SYSTEM TO ABUNDANCE AND WORLD PEACE A Unified Engineering Blueprint for the Post-Scarcity Age
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: COMPLETE GOVERNANCE SYSTEM TO ABUNDANCE AND WORLD PEACE A Unified Engineering Blueprint for the Post-Scarcity Age
detail.abstract: Whoever saves a single life saves an entire world-isn't it fair to listen also to that one voice?-Kaveh Dimitri Salahi PREFACE This proposal does not come from a scholar, a government-funded agency, or an institution. It comes from a simple human being with a voice and a solution. Priority Arts Initiative exists on the belief that every voice counts-that every voice reflects what it means to be a human being. History's greatest transformations were rarely born inside institutions. Institutions are funded by the old system and structurally incentivized to protect it. This voice carries no such conflict of interest. Only a idea, and the conviction to share it. SUMMARY Humanity stands at a crossroads. We face converging crises: mass job displacement from artificial intelligence, accelerating climate change, persistent energy poverty, and deepening geopolitical conflict over scarce resources. At the same time, we possess the technological capacity to eliminate scarcity itself. This paper presents a complete, integrated governance and infrastructure system designed to guide humanity from an age of survival and competition into an age of abundance and cooperation. The framework rests on four interconnected pillars: Axiocracy-A governance model grounded in human worth, universal production rights, and equitable access to infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"优先艺术倡议"（Priority Arts Initiative），这是一个基于人类价值、全民生产权和公平基础设施获取的综合性治理体系框架，旨在引导人类从生存竞争时代走向富足合作时代，应对AI失业、气候变化、能源贫困和地缘冲突等 converging crises。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个完整的治理与基础设施系统，引导人类社会从生存与竞争时代转向富足与合作时代？
AI.motivation: 人类面临人工智能导致的大规模失业、加速的气候变化、持续的能源贫困以及因资源稀缺而加剧的地缘政治冲突等多重危机，同时我们已拥有消除稀缺本身的科技能力，亟需一套整合性的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"每一个声音都重要"的人本主义信念；Axiocracy（价值治理）模型——一种以人类价值、全民生产权和公平基础设施获取为基石的新型治理模式。
AI.method: 该文提出的是概念性框架提案，而非实证研究。它描述了一个四支柱整合系统的设计思路。
AI.findings: 尚未呈现具体研究发现，因为该文件是一份提案/倡议书，而非已完成的研究论文，需要进一步实施和验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"Axiocracy"这一新型治理概念，将人类价值置于治理核心，挑战了传统机构驱动的变革范式，主张从个体声音出发的底层变革路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为应对AI失业、气候危机、能源贫困和资源冲突等现实问题提供了一个整合性的治理与基础设施系统框架，具有一定的实践参考价值。

title: PAC Intelligence System 2028–2034 (PIS-2034): A Computational Governance Framework for the Common Agricultural Policy

detail.title: PAC Intelligence System 2028–2034 (PIS-2034): A Computational Governance Framework for the Common Agricultural Policy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: L’autore dichiara di non avere conflitti di interesse finanziari o relazioni istituzionali suscettibili di aver influenzato i contenuti, le analisi e le conclusioni del presente lavoro.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Il presente lavoro non coinvolge sperimentazioni cliniche, dati sanitari personali o attività di ricerca soggette ad approvazione etica formale. L’opera si basa su analisi metodologiche, modelli teorici, fonti normative e dati istituzionali pubblicamente disponibili.

contentFormat.other: Framework metodologico di governance computazionale applicata all’agricoltura europea

detail.abstract: The Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) faces a structural governance crisis: persistently elevated error rates (2.0–5.0%, European Court of Auditors 2015–2023), systematic benefit take-up gaps among vulnerable beneficiary categories, and administrative capacity differentials across Member States and paying agencies. This working paper proposes a computational governance paradigm for the CAP 2028–2034 programming cycle, grounded in six original analytical models: the European Index of CAP Administrative Complexity (IECAP), the CAP Irregularity Risk Scoring Framework (RISK), a New Five-Axis Taxonomy of CAP Measures, the CAP Accessibility Model (MEAP), the Agricultural Territorial Vulnerability Atlas (PVT), and the CAP Territorial Governance Model 2030 (MGT-2030). Each model is formally specified with mathematical equations, variable operationalisation, methodological limitations and an empirical validation roadmap following the OECD/JRC Handbook on Constructing Composite Indicators. The work concludes with a normative proposal for the introduction of a mandatory Complexity Impact Assessment (CIA) in CAP Regulation 2028, analogous to the regulatory impact assessment already required for European Commission acts under the Better Regulation Guidelines. The framework is grounded in the administrative burden literature (Herd and Moynihan, 2018), multilevel governance theory (Hooghe and Marks, 2003) and computational social science (Lazer et al., 2009).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套包含6个原创分析模型的计算治理框架，用于解决CAP的结构性治理危机，并建议在2028年CAP法规中引入强制性复杂性影响评估（CIA）。
AI.research_question: 如何通过计算治理范式解决CAP面临的高错误率、福利覆盖缺口及成员国行政能力差异等结构性治理危机？
AI.motivation: CAP长期存在2.0-5.0%的持续高错误率、弱势受益群体系统性福利获取缺口以及成员国/支付机构间的行政能力差异，现有治理模式难以应对这些结构性危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政负担理论（Herd & Moynihan, 2018）、多层治理理论（Hooghe & Marks, 2003）、计算社会科学（Lazer et al., 2009）
AI.method: 开发6个原创分析模型：IECAP、RISK、新五轴分类法、MEAP、PVT、MGT-2030，每个模型均包含数学公式、变量操作化、方法局限及基于OECD/JRC手册的实证验证路线图。
AI.findings: 提出了一套可操作的计算治理框架，并建议在CAP 2028法规中引入强制性复杂性影响评估（CIA），类比欧盟《更好监管指南》中的监管影响评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 将行政负担理论、多层治理理论与计算社会科学方法整合，为CAP治理提供了可量化的分析工具和理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为CAP 2028-2034规划周期提供了具体的计算治理工具包，以及强制性复杂性影响评估（CIA）的政策建议。

title: Is Geopolitics ending the IMF's role as Lender of Last Resort? - University of Oxford (St Antony's International Review)

detail.title: Is Geopolitics ending the IMF's role as Lender of Last Resort? - University of Oxford (St Antony's International Review)

publicationDetails.detailsText: St Antony's International Review, University of Oxford

detail.abstract:
This article examines how rising geopolitical tensions and shifting global economic power are eroding the International Monetary Fund's credibility as a neutral lender of last resort. Established at Bretton Woods in 1944 under American leadership, the IMF has long served as an instrument of U.S. soft power, with Washington retaining effective veto authority through its 16.49% voting share. However, the 21st-century rise of China, now the world's largest bilateral lender and creditor to developing nations, has fundamentally altered this landscape.

Three cases illustrate the IMF's growing politicization: Sri Lanka's 2022 debt restructuring, where China challenged the principle of multilateral debt seniority; the Russia-Ukraine conflict, during which the IMF cancelled its Moscow mission while expanding lending to Kyiv; and Argentina's $20 billion program, perceived by some board members as politically driven due to President Milei's alignment with Washington. Similar patterns appear in lending to Egypt, Pakistan, and Ukraine, all geopolitically strategic nations. Meanwhile, China's bilateral rescue lending has reached over 40% of IMF levels, positioning Beijing as a credible alternative.

To preserve its relevance, the IMF must strengthen independent decision-making, recalibrate voting shares to reflect contemporary economic realities, and establish clearer multilateral debt restructuring frameworks through G20 cooperation.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨地缘政治紧张和全球经济力量转移如何侵蚀IMF作为中立最后贷款人的信誉。通过分析斯里兰卡债务重组、俄乌冲突、阿根廷贷款等案例，揭示IMF日益政治化，而中国作为替代性双边贷款方的崛起正在挑战其主导地位。
AI.research_question: 地缘政治紧张和全球经济力量转移如何影响IMF作为中立最后贷款人的信誉？
AI.motivation: IMF作为布雷顿森林体系产物长期被视为美国软实力工具，但21世纪中国崛起成为最大双边贷款方，改变了全球金融治理格局，亟需重新审视IMF的中立性与合法性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际政治经济学中的霸权稳定论与制度信誉理论，涉及最后贷款人角色、投票权分配与国际组织政治化等概念。
AI.method: 多案例比较研究，选取斯里兰卡（2022年债务重组）、俄乌冲突、阿根廷（200亿美元贷款）三个典型案例，辅以埃及、巴基斯坦、乌克兰等国的佐证性分析。
AI.findings: （1）IMF贷款决策日益受地缘政治因素驱动，而非纯经济考量；（2）中国挑战了多边债务优先原则，且双边救援贷款已达IMF水平的40%以上；（3）美国通过16.49%的投票权保留事实否决权，但这一权力基础正被侵蚀。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了对国际金融组织政治化程度的实证理解，揭示了传统霸权与新崛起力量在金融治理领域的制度竞争机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为IMF改革提供路径建议：强化独立决策、重新校准投票份额以反映现实经济格局、通过G20合作建立更清晰的多边债务重组框架。

detail.abstract: This paper conducts a PRISMA-based systematic review of pension research on Cyprus, focusing on how gender is addressed. Using a structured screening process, a final sample of studies is evaluated through a gender-audit framework distinguishing between central and partial gender analysis. The findings show that only a limited number of studies treat gender as a core analytical dimension, while most incorporate it indirectly or as a secondary variable. This uneven integration limits the understanding of gendered pension outcomes. The review highlights methodological and data gaps and stresses the need for gender-sensitive research and policy approaches addressing life-course inequalities and structural disparities.

AI.method: PRISMA系统性文献综述，结构化筛选流程，对最终样本进行性别审计评估。
